file.name: UI\Content\HeroClasses_HeroClasses_0_Description.txt
file.text: A Protector is the main participant in a team battle. He is the first to attack the enemy, preventing foes from attacking his allies. Protectors have high survivability and strong crowd control.

file.name: UI\Content\HeroClasses_HeroClasses_1_Description.txt
file.text: Vanguards combine survivability with high attack power and control of a single target. They enter the battle right behind the more tenacious Protectors and sow chaos in the enemy's ranks.

file.name: UI\Content\HeroClasses_HeroClasses_2_Description.txt
file.text: Slayers attack rarely, but extremely quickly, dealing great damage. However, their defense is poor. Therefore, in team battles, Slayers wait for just the right moment to attack (usually when the Protectors and Vanguards are already deep in battle).

file.name: UI\Content\HeroClasses_HeroClasses_3_Description.txt
file.text: Fighters deal the most damage, but their attacks take time. As their allies protect them, Fighters kill the enemy one by one.

file.name: UI\Content\HeroClasses_HeroClasses_4_Description.txt
file.text: Support heroes are not very strong by themselves, but they are irreplaceable in a team battle: they determine the battle's outcome by saving allies and controlling enemies at the right moment.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_premiumVisualInfo_premiumTooltipAddition.txt
file.text: This talent has been received courtesy of the Golden Age of one of your teammates

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_0_tipText.txt
file.text: Dealing a deathblow to enemy soldiers gets you more Prime.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_10_tipText.txt
file.text: You can view your heroes’ talents and stats from the menu that opens when you right-click on a hero’s portrait.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_11_tipText.txt
file.text: You can add players to your friends list from the menu that opens when you right-click on a hero’s portrait.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_12_tipText.txt
file.text: To toggle between chat channels, enter “/a” (all) or “/t” (team) in the chat window (without quotation marks).

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_13_tipText.txt
file.text: You can quickly return the camera to your hero by pressing the spacebar.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_14_tipText.txt
file.text: Use F10 to take a screenshot.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_15_tipText.txt
file.text: Use F11 to view technical data about the game client.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_16_tipText.txt
file.text: Upgrading a talent with a similar talent is guaranteed to raise the upgraded talent’s level by 1.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_17_tipText.txt
file.text: You can continue playing with the same allies if you confirm that desire after the battle.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_18_tipText.txt
file.text: When a flag is raised, invisible heroes are visible to enemies.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_19_tipText.txt
file.text: Use the "Portal" button to move quickly while on Native Terrain.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_1_tipText.txt
file.text: Native Terrain gives a team a tangible advantage. Raise your flags and strike the flags of your opponents.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_20_tipText.txt
file.text: When a hero activates a talent, their level goes up and their stats increase.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_21_tipText.txt
file.text: Don't stand next to an enemy tower unless you're accompanied by allied soldiers!

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_22_tipText.txt
file.text: Killing Woodwoses in the Golden Camps of the Touched can earn you glyphs, which significantly strengthen your hero.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_23_tipText.txt
file.text: Having allied support when killing an enemy hero earns you extra Prime.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_24_tipText.txt
file.text: A hero's resurrection time depends on their current level.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_25_tipText.txt
file.text: To view gameplay statistics, press and hold the Tab key.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_26_tipText.txt
file.text: You can find Touched camps in the forest. Your hero can earn Prime by destroying them.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_27_tipText.txt
file.text: Be polite to other players to ensure a pleasant, easy-going game atmosphere, which will increase your chances of winning.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_28_tipText.txt
file.text: Hold down the Alt key while clicking on an area on the mini-map to call your allies' attention to an important point in the game.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_29_tipText.txt
file.text: Hold down the Alt key while clicking on an enemy hero to mark them as a target for your allies.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_2_tipText.txt
file.text: Never share the username and password for your account with anyone. Playing with other people’s accounts is prohibited by the rules of Prime World.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_30_tipText.txt
file.text: Hold down the Alt key and click on an allied hero to tell your allies that player is in danger.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_31_tipText.txt
file.text: Be careful when linking talents to heroes. It costs extra to change a talent's owner.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_32_tipText.txt
file.text: Lanterns and Potions of Alertness help your team gain better control of the map and see invisible characters in the regions they are active in.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_33_tipText.txt
file.text: Don't forget to occasionally visit the lairs of Kiton and the Fire Drake with allied support — defeating these terrifying foes will earn your team a significant amount of Prime.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_34_tipText.txt
file.text: Heroes regenerate Health and Energy very quickly at their faction base.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_35_tipText.txt
file.text: You can trade talents with your friends using the clan bank.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_36_tipText.txt
file.text: Heroes earns a significant amount of Prime for their first kill. Be extremely observant at the beginning of the game!

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_37_tipText.txt
file.text: You can send a hero to a point outside of the visible area by clicking on the corresponding area on the mini-map.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_38_tipText.txt
file.text: Some talents are actually upgrades for other talents and do not have their own effects. Make sure you've already learned the original, upgradeable talent before learning these talents.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_39_tipText.txt
file.text: Using special flags is a great way to highlight the individuality of their owners.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_3_tipText.txt
file.text: The number of talents received in a battle against players depends on the number of points received for that battle, as well as your hero’s title.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_40_tipText.txt
file.text: You can change your character control settings in the game menu.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_41_tipText.txt
file.text: Keep up with Prime World news, contests, and special offers on the game's official website and social networks!

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_42_tipText.txt
file.text: You can find a schedule of battle modes on the official website.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_43_tipText.txt
file.text: You can change your hero's appearance in your Castle for an extra fee.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_44_tipText.txt
file.text: Warn your allies if an enemy has abandoned a previously defended lane. This will help prevent your allies from falling victim to a surprise attack.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_45_tipText.txt
file.text: The Prime earned for killing enemy soldiers is split among all allies, but your hero will earn much more Prime if you are the one to deal the fatal blow.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_46_tipText.txt
file.text: A spell can be interrupted by moving, pressing the Esc key, and certain enemy heroes' skills.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_47_tipText.txt
file.text: No hero can be linked to more than two talents that belong to another hero.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_48_tipText.txt
file.text: Don't leave a lane you're defending for very long without warning your allies. The enemy can obtain a serious advantage by destroying your tower.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_49_tipText.txt
file.text: Don't leave a lane you're defending for very long without warning your allies. The enemy can obtain a serious advantage by destroying your tower.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_4_tipText.txt
file.text: Minigame scrolls can give a team a decisive advantage when used at just the right time.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_50_tipText.txt
file.text: If you like the way an ally plays, add them to your friends list!

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_51_tipText.txt
file.text: Keep track of positive and negative effects applied to your character.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_52_tipText.txt
file.text: Some rare talents are parts of unique sets. If you manage to collect a full talent set, your hero will earn a sizable additional bonus.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_53_tipText.txt
file.text: Deserters - players, who left the battle or deliberately betrayed their teams in action. Matchmaking brings such players together in groups, and their battle rewards are significantly reduced.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_54_tipText.txt
file.text: The higher your hero's Power stat is, the stronger they are on the battlefield. Don't forget to upgrade your talents in your Castle!

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_55_tipText.txt
file.text: In addition to other bonuses, Golden Age gives you an additional talent in battle. And, if you win, it gives you two talents for every other ally with Golden Age!

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_56_tipText.txt
file.text: Don't be afraid to experiment with your heroes' builds. Try various stat combinations!

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_57_tipText.txt
file.text: You can purchase the missing resources to finish an operation in the Castle at any moment.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_58_tipText.txt
file.text: Even at your Castle’s lowest levels, you can hire heroes level 10 or higher instantly for gold.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_59_tipText.txt
file.text: The Cat's House and Dog’ House don't just increase the amount of resources you produce, they also allow you to get in-game pets!

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_5_tipText.txt
file.text: Some squads of Touched are stronger than others, and you receive more Prime for defeating them. They are marked with a golden symbol on the minimap.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_60_tipText.txt
file.text: Do not quit a battle unless you have a strong reason. If you refuse to return to the battle, your hero’s rating goes down and you might get status of a Deserter!

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_61_tipText.txt
file.text: Make sure you have a Treasure Room in your Castle. This special building produces gold every day!

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_62_tipText.txt
file.text: Signing up for Golden Age doubles resource production in your castle and in battle and increases the amount of experience earned by heroes and lords after a battle!

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_63_tipText.txt
file.text: Your chances of getting exclusive talents are higher, when Golden Age is active!

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_64_tipText.txt
file.text: You can switch factions via the game menu in your Castle.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_65_tipText.txt
file.text: You can change your lord's name via the game menu in your Castle.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_66_tipText.txt
file.text: Fighting in clan battles gives you access to special new items.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_67_tipText.txt
file.text: You will lose unspent Tactics Points if you leave your clan, but you will be able to keep all the items you've obtained.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_68_tipText.txt
file.text: To obtain Tactics Points and Strategy Points, you must purchase a special upgrade in the clan store.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_69_tipText.txt
file.text: All clans fight in the clan wars — everyone is important in the pyramid of power!

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_6_tipText.txt
file.text: Allied towers and soldiers will attack the opponent’s heroes if the latter attack allied heroes.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_70_tipText.txt
file.text: Players that have been reported for their lack of sportsmanship might subsequently get status of a Deserter.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_71_tipText.txt
file.text: Players that have been reported for insulting other players might subsequently lose the opportunity of using chat.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_72_tipText.txt
file.text: You can disable chat at any time in your game settings or by using the special button next to the chat in the session.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_73_tipText.txt
file.text: Disarming prevents an enemy from attacking, but still allows using any talent.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_74_tipText.txt
file.text: Disarming prevents an enemy from attacking, but still allows using any talent.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_75_tipText.txt
file.text: Silence prevents an enemy from using any talent, but allows attacking.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_76_tipText.txt
file.text: Blindness increases the attack Miss Chance up to 75% and reduces the visibility range.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_77_tipText.txt
file.text: Сamouflage is invisibility that is broken off by any damage.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_78_tipText.txt
file.text: Moving invisible heroes can be recognized by ripples that they leave.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_79_tipText.txt
file.text: You can get any particular talent by completing special quest from the Talents Collection.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_7_tipText.txt
file.text: Don’t forget to activate your hero’s talents! Suggested talents will appear above the Prime indicator.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_80_tipText.txt
file.text: Crystal shards can be exchanged for special quests in Talents Collection.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_81_tipText.txt
file.text: You can sell exclusive and legendary talents and get crystal shards.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_82_tipText.txt
file.text: Every hero has two ultimate talents. Do not miss an opportunity to unlock hero's potential!

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_83_tipText.txt
file.text: Choose such upgrading class talent of the V stage that matches better to your playing style.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_84_tipText.txt
file.text: The familiar hero's gameplay can be significantly changed by combining different ultimate talents, upgrades and characteristics.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_85_tipText.txt
file.text: During the night hero's visibility range is reduced. Stay focused and do not forget to use Lanterns.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_86_tipText.txt
file.text: Some heroes and talents have special characteristics that depend on the time of day.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_87_tipText.txt
file.text: In the Castle you can get acces to special Events with valuable rewards. Do not miss an opportunity to win a prize!

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_88_tipText.txt
file.text: Talents upgraded to six and more stars can be aquired by participating in special Events as well as in the Clan Shop or at the Fair

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_8_tipText.txt
file.text: Forest Shops sell minigame scrolls and unique items, as well as lamps and potions.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_90_tipText.txt
file.text: For every hero in the Castle you can custumize in detail quick targeting of talents, by checking corresponded boxed on the panel of active talents.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_91_tipText.txt
file.text: As a reward, the most active players of the top Conflict clans every week get chests with exclusive and legendary talents, upgraded from four to seven stars.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_92_tipText.txt
file.text: The duration of the season in Prime World is three months. Every player gets a reward, matching the league of their heroes at the end of the season.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_93_tipText.txt
file.text: Heroes' rating determines league that the hero belongs to: wooden, stone, bronze, silver, gold and legend.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_94_tipText.txt
file.text: In the end of the season players with the heroes in bronze league and higher get additional rewards. In addition to crystals and flag they get the unique frame, the skin of the season and a chest with a legendary talent.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_95_tipText.txt
file.text: The more Strategy Points you get for your clan during the Conflict, the higher level of the clan shop is and therefore the larger variety of goods.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_96_tipText.txt
file.text: Level of the clan shop resets every Friday, use the opportunity to buy valuable goods before it happens.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_97_tipText.txt
file.text: Clan’s Strategy Points and player’s Tactics Points reset every Friday, the latter also reset if you leave the clan.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_98_tipText.txt
file.text: You can get the first victory bonus twice a day: wining against the Touched in a Challenge and against other heroes in Borderlands.

file.name: UI\Content\_.UIDT_tips_9_tipText.txt
file.text: Battle talents have a shared cooldown period and can be used at 15-second intervals.

file.name: UI\Content\MarketingEvents\BuildGoldenLodge_tooltipA.txt
file.text:
Treasury

Congratulations! You earned the Treasury, a building that produces gold every day!
The Treasury also increases the Castles Population.

You will find the Treasury in your Building Storage - all you need to do is place it in your Castle.

file.name: UI\Content\MarketingEvents\BuyFlag_tooltipA.txt
file.text:
Flags

Choose a flag from multiple free flags of countries or "Special" flags.

file.name: UI\Content\MarketingEvents\BuyGoldenLodge_tooltipA.txt
file.text:
Treasury

The Treasury is a building that produces gold every day!
The Treasury also increases the Castles Population.

Build the Treasury in your Castle for just

file.name: UI\Content\MarketingEvents\BuyGoldHero_tooltipA.txt
file.text:
Hero for Gold

Hire any hero that requires castle level and higher for gold right now, even if your castle level isn't supposed to let you purchase one as of yet.

file.name: UI\Content\MarketingEvents\BuyGoldHero_youAlreadyBoughtAllEventHeroes.txt
file.text:
You have already hired all the heroes who meet the conditions of this special.
Wait for new heroes to come out!

file.name: UI\Content\MarketingEvents\BuyHero_tooltipA.txt
file.text:
Treasure House

Complete a payment of any amount to get the Treasure House, a special Castle building that produces gold.
Each day the Treasure House will refill your treasury by 1!

file.name: UI\Content\MarketingEvents\BuySpecialHero_tooltipA.txt
file.text:
A new hero right away!

Hire a hero for right now, even if your castle level isn't supposed to let you purchase one as of yet.

By the way, you can hire a hero for silver too, if all the necessary conditions are met.

file.name: UI\Content\MarketingEvents\BuySteamDLC_tooltipA.txt
file.text: Purchase Steam downloadable content in the game directly!

file.name: UI\Content\MarketingEvents\BuyTournamentTicketEvent_tooltipA.txt
file.text:
Prime Arena - is a new experimental tournament where you can get a possibility to win money or Gold!
The more matches you win, the more precious the price is! You don't actually have to play with one team only. Gather players right before the battle! Matches are held on a special game server , where all heroes and talents are available and players are all in the same conditions.
Register till !DATE_TIME_HERE!.
Having purchased a ticket, you receive a random violet talent as a gift.
For more information visit our site.

file.name: UI\Content\MarketingEvents\FirstBuy_tooltipA.txt
file.text:
First Purchase

Get yourself a pet to live in your castle, and it will accompany your Heroes into battle.

Apart from that, the amount of resources and number of talents stored in the castle will increase by and respectively.

All of your heroes, including those you will hire in the future, will receive experience (the effects are non-cumulative).

Immediately after construction you will receive , , , .

Produces one of the following resources once a day: , , , , .

file.name: UI\Content\MarketingEvents\FirstBuy_youAlreadyBoughtAllFirstBuyHouses.txt
file.text:
You have already built all the pet houses that meet the conditions of this special.
Wait for new pets to come out!

file.name: UI\Content\MarketingEvents\FirstBuy_youAlreadyBoughtAllFirstBuyHousesAndPutItInPocket.txt
file.text:
You have already built all the houses for qualifying pets and stored them in the Building Storage.
Keep on the lookout for new pets!

file.name: UI\Content\MarketingEvents\GoldLamp_0_tooltipA.txt
file.text:
White Rune

You can use White Rune to unassign any talent.

file.name: Social\UITexts\SocialClientUITexts_items_1210_text.txt
file.text:
Take part in updated clan wars!

Every week: help your clan get as many Strategy Points as possible and unlock the highest levels of the store with your clanmates! Every week, the Tactics Points and Strategy Points you’ve collected will be reset along with the store level. To get points as a reward for battle, you must buy the special upgrade Art of Assault in the clan store.

In the clan store, you can buy:
• Any stat upgrades.
• Exclusive and new legendary clan talents.
• Various chests with improved talents.
• Prime Crystals.
• Legendary Crystals.
• Crystal Shards.

file.name: Social\UITexts\SocialClientUITexts_items_1220_text.txt

file.name: Social\UITexts\SocialClientUITexts_items_1221_text.txt
file.text:
Talent collection

The talent collection provides information about all the existing talents in the game and allows you to get them as a reward for special tasks. When you complete quests in the Tavern, you’ll earn a special resource - Crystal Shards. After collecting the required number of Shards, you can select any talent available in the collection and start a unique, time-limited quest. If you complete it in time, you’ll get the talent you chose!

file.name: Social\UITexts\SocialClientUITexts_items_1225_text.txt
file.text:
Shared Strategy Point pool

During the event time, all clans have access to a shared pool of Strategy Points. When fighting for the Borderlands, clans earn Strategy Points until the pool is completely exhausted. Battle Logistics increases Strategy Point income for the clan, but does not influence the deduction from the shared pool.

file.name: Social\UITexts\SocialClientUITexts_items_1226_text.txt
file.text:
Clan rating

The more Strategy Points the clan earns, the higher the available store level. The clan rating stops growing if the shared Strategy Point pool is exhausted.

file.name: Social\UITexts\SocialClientUITexts_items_1230_text.txt
file.text:
Clan Search

Keep track of the best clans in the game. You can see clan ratings from the previous Fight and progress in the current one in this list. Press the magnifying glass to find a clan that interests you by name.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_0.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: Everything might be quiet and peaceful in the domain, but this is no time for complacency. Send your heroes off to patrol the area — better safe than sorry.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_01_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: A small squad of Touched has invaded our domain and is now attacking villages. Send your heroes off to put a stop to the Touched incursion!

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_02_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: It’s never too late to learn! Take your heroes outside the castle walls and drill them with some field exercises. Train hard, fight easy!

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_03_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: Our scouts have discovered a smugglers’ den right here in our domain. We must attack the miscreants and confiscate their smuggled goods.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_04_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: Your castle isn’t guarded by heroes alone. Regular soldiers also need to be ready for battle at all times, and the best way to provide for this is to entrust their training to one of your heroes.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_05_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: A merchant caravan is crossing your lands. Supply it with guards, and the merchants will reward you generously.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_06_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: Some local woodcutters have found their way deep into a hostile forest area, disturbing a host of satyrs in their lair. Rush to their aid and save the woodcutters.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_07_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: An inspector has arrived from the capital. If our most esteemed guest deems our castle worthy, we can count on free shippings for construction materials.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_08_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: The fields of your domain have been blessed with great abundance this year — the peasants cannot harvest everything by themselves and are asking for help. Sometimes it behooves even heroes to apply themselves to such pedestrian tasks.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_09_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: You have managed to obtain some Old Empire manuscripts found by hunters in the Prime Zone. A study of these documents may have a positive effect on the development of your heroes’ skills.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_10_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: One of the hunters who has just returned from the Prime Zone claims to have seen a valuable artifact in an Amanita den. Send your heroes forth to defeat the Touched and salvage this valuable object.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_11_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: A Defender airship has landed near our border. These valiant fighters against the Touched are asking for our assistance in repairing their craft and have promised to share some of the artifacts they have recovered with you.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_12_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: The Amanita may not be the brightest creatures in the Prime Zone, but they just might be the strongest. You will need truly superhuman strength to fight an entire horde of them and destroy their den.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_13_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: There are many catacombs beneath the castles that were destroyed in the Cataclysm, and they still guard their secrets well. Ingenuous locks and insidious traps await anyone who dares to disturb the deathly silence of these subterranean crypts.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_14_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: Scouts report that a group of roving bandits intends to spend the night in the forests of our domain. It’s high time we taught these impudent dogs a lesson!

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_15_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: Merchant caravans are getting attacked more and more frequently, and it’s all happening in your lands. Nobody knows whether the Touched or human robbers are to blame, but the problem needs to be taken care of with all due haste!

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_16_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: An itinerant architect suggests we conduct a daring experiment: the economical Prime construction of a defense tower. He can’t do it without the help of your heroes!

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_17_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: Enemy forces have surrounded the ruins of the destroyed village and apparently intend to build a fort of their own on its site. Drive the enemy away from your territory and reclaim the valuable construction materials.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_18_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: The Touched have attacked one of the villages of your domain! You must go at once and save the defenseless villagers!

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_19_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: The Touched cache discovered by the hunters may contain a large number of natural Prime Crystals, but only the bravest heroes will be able to cope with the hardships of this campaign.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_20_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: You should not openly attack the shops operated by the Touched — they can be very useful to our heroes in battle. However, no one will think less of you if you manage to purloin a few Prime Crystals without getting caught.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_21_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: Send your heroes to the Prime Zone — they must brave its dangers to hold out against the rampages of the Touched and defend the borders of your domain.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_22_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: Local hunters report new types of anomalies in the Prime Zone. You must study them personally to assess their danger. Immortal heroes are the best candidates for such a job.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_23_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: Bandits have infiltrated your castle under cover of darkness and paid a visit to one of your treasuries — however, one of your heroes managed to drive them off. We must chase them at once, while their trail is still hot!

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_24_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: A merchant from Fichter promises great treasure for what appears to be a simple Prime Zone expedition. We shall set forth, but let us be wary — the heroes are very likely to encounter a few “unforeseen circumstances.”

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_25_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: We have an unusual guest: Woodwose, Lord of the Forest. We must drive him away at once before he can wreak a great deal of havoc in our domain.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_26_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: A hunting expedition disappeared in one of the nearby areas of the Prime Zone a couple of days ago. We will need to check their maps and follow their itinerary if we intend to find them.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_27_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: One of the army field generals is visiting our domain. His leadership is crucial to the war effort, so escorting him is a task that will take top priority for the next few days.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_28_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: Take part in a Prime Zone campaign wrought with perils to find one of the lost artifacts of the Old Imperium.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_29_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: One of the pilgrims has decided to draw a detailed map of the Prime Zone indicating the routes of migrating anomalies. Hardened heroes with experience in the Prime Zone will be most welcome to join him.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_30_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: You can earn a pretty penny at the Fichter Fair... as long as you know how to haggle.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_31_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: Dragonwald Valley is renowned for its treasures. We have to clean up the valley so we can build some solid fortifications there.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_32_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: One of the Outposts has been destroyed by the enemy and requires immediate repairs.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_33_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: Hunting in Touched-infested woods is a dangerous proposition. However, when you’ve been tracking game for days and it escapes into the borderland woods, pursuing it becomes a matter of principle.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_34_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: One of the Prime deposits in the Prime Zone has entered the phase of maximum productivity. Send heroes at once to grab all the Prime they can lay their hands on and return as quickly as possible.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_35_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: A neighboring lord is holding a tournament. No magic, no military machinations — only brute force will be permitted. Send heroes to take part in the tournament and earn your just reward.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_36_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: Our enemies have gone quiet — there hasn’t been a border raid in days. We must send our heroes over to investigate the reasons for this strange lull.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_37_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: The temple of the ancient gods discovered in the Prime Zone has recently become a favorite hiding place for all the Touched for miles around. We need to launch a dangerous Prime Zone expedition to destroy the ancient holy place.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_38_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: Some of the artifacts found in the Prime Zone only become charged with talent properties after a long and arduous refinement process. Only the most intelligent heroes can recognize and exploit this kind of potential in an object.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_39_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: A sweet-voiced Siren has decided to settle in our domain, and her songs are already attracting dazed travelers, as well as the Touched. Only the most stalwart heroes can keep their wits about them when they hear her voice.

file.name: Social\Constructions\Buildings\Quest\Tavern_40_1.TAVERNQUEST_description.txt
file.text: A Fire Drake has built a lair near our borders. Only the most resilient heroes can hold their own against the King of the Touched!

file.name: MiniGames\MiniGame01\Description\ClinicDescription_bonuses_0_description.txt
file.text: Allows you to completely clean the selected location.

file.name: MiniGames\MiniGame01\Description\ClinicDescription_bonuses_10_description.txt
file.text: When a pet restores a portion of its Health, its friend will also recover some health.

file.name: MiniGames\MiniGame01\Description\ClinicDescription_bonuses_11_description.txt
file.text: Pets will be less upset about not getting what they want in such a beautiful kennel.

file.name: MiniGames\MiniGame01\Description\ClinicDescription_bonuses_12_description.txt
file.text: Not just attractive, but convenient, too! These boots will let you make your way through the kennel much faster.

file.name: MiniGames\MiniGame01\Description\ClinicDescription_bonuses_13_description.txt
file.text: Increases the time that a pet sitting on a mat will be willing to wait to get what it wants.

file.name: MiniGames\MiniGame01\Description\ClinicDescription_bonuses_14_description.txt
file.text: Cleans everywhere instantly. Replaces the conventional Broom.

file.name: MiniGames\MiniGame01\Description\ClinicDescription_bonuses_15_description.txt
file.text: Now your pets won't make the place so dirty.

file.name: MiniGames\MiniGame01\Description\ClinicDescription_bonuses_16_description.txt
file.text: All the pets from Best Kennel restore additional Health. Each pet will also give you 100 extra coins.

file.name: MiniGames\MiniGame01\Description\ClinicDescription_bonuses_17_description.txt
file.text: Instantly applies the Magic Broom, Candy and Fireworks effects for all pets.

file.name: MiniGames\MiniGame01\Description\ClinicDescription_bonuses_1_description.txt
file.text: Your pet will be better trained on such a comfortable flooring.

file.name: MiniGames\MiniGame01\Description\ClinicDescription_bonuses_2_description.txt
file.text: Give one of these brochures to any pet and it will forget its current desires and agree to follow you anywhere.

file.name: MiniGames\MiniGame01\Description\ClinicDescription_bonuses_3_description.txt
file.text: Your pets will recover more Health while eating.

file.name: MiniGames\MiniGame01\Description\ClinicDescription_bonuses_4_description.txt
file.text: No pet will be able to sleep through this alarm clock!

file.name: MiniGames\MiniGame01\Description\ClinicDescription_bonuses_5_description.txt
file.text: Paved paths allow you to move quickly through the kennel.

file.name: MiniGames\MiniGame01\Description\ClinicDescription_bonuses_6_description.txt
file.text: All you have to do is approach a lazy pet with a whip in hand and it will immediately be cured of its laziness.

file.name: MiniGames\MiniGame01\Description\ClinicDescription_bonuses_7_description.txt
file.text: Your pet's Health is restored by itself while you hold it in your arms.

file.name: MiniGames\MiniGame01\Description\ClinicDescription_bonuses_8_description.txt
file.text: Pets become cheerful and get extra Health at the start.

file.name: MiniGames\MiniGame01\Description\ClinicDescription_bonuses_9_description.txt
file.text: Give your pet a candy and it will get an immediate Health boost.

file.name: MiniGames\MiniGame01\Description\ClinicDescription_levels_0_description.txt
file.text: Pets come to the kennel healthy.

file.name: MiniGames\MiniGame01\Description\ClinicDescription_levels_10_description.txt
file.text: It has been rumored that the kennel has some filthy visitors!

file.name: MiniGames\MiniGame01\Description\ClinicDescription_levels_11_description.txt
file.text: This is the most difficult time in the kennel and it will take every last effort to end the day well.

file.name: MiniGames\MiniGame01\Description\ClinicDescription_levels_1_description.txt
file.text: The pets are already befriending one another.

file.name: MiniGames\MiniGame01\Description\ClinicDescription_levels_2_description.txt
file.text: The pets have become lazy and they loaf around, whining about their desires.

file.name: MiniGames\MiniGame01\Description\ClinicDescription_levels_3_description.txt
file.text: A bathtub has arrived at the kennel! All of the pets want to try it out.

file.name: MiniGames\MiniGame01\Description\ClinicDescription_levels_4_description.txt
file.text: The pets are basking in the sun and losing interest in everything else.

file.name: MiniGames\MiniGame01\Description\ClinicDescription_levels_5_description.txt
file.text: What a mess! The kennel is in dire need of a good cleaning.

file.name: MiniGames\MiniGame01\Description\ClinicDescription_levels_6_description.txt

Single player mode.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_boarMasterQuest_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: What do we have here... Another deserter?

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_boarMasterQuest_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: Negative, good hero! I survived of the sweet charms of the treacherous Sirens!

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_boarMasterQuest_phrasesA_2_textMale.txt
file.text: Trying to bluster your way out, are you? Well you won't fool me!

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_boarMasterQuest_phrasesA_3_textMale.txt
file.text: I've been concussed! Hard of hearing—that's what I am. It's the only reason I survived!

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_boarMasterQuest_phrasesA_4_textMale.txt
file.text: You do hear me, don't you? I'm not wispering too quiet, am I—you deserter scum!

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_boarMasterQuest_phrasesA_5_textMale.txt
file.text: What is wrong with you? Seriously. No stomach for blood? Feeling a little guilty about deserting your friends? Never fear, old boy—we'll save your friends. But you'll have to serve at the outpost once we're done.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_boarMasterQuest_phrasesA_6_textMale.txt
file.text: Exactly.Their nests are right there at the edge of the forest. That's where they're holding friends captive!

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_boarMasterQuest_phrasesA_7_textMale.txt
file.text: You really are hard of hearing. Let's go, Nameless. I've always wanted to hear a Siren's song.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_meetIva_phrasesA_10_textMale.txt
file.text: We'll make it somehow, Willow. I promised I would save you, and I have never broken my word. Even if this hero and the Babbler abandon us, and I must manage alone.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_meetIva_phrasesA_11_textMale.txt
file.text: Abandon us?! Do they mean to?

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_meetIva_phrasesA_12_textMale.txt
file.text: My my, talk about drama! The Knight of the Rueful Countenance versus Sourpuss Pepperbox. Act I: Preparing to Die.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_meetIva_phrasesA_14_textMale.txt
file.text: How will this play out in the end? The audience waits with baited breath!

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_meetIva_phrasesA_15_textMale.txt
file.text: Enough nonsense. Let us begin. We must strengthen the outpost.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_meetIva_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: Well... I can certainly poke someone to death, and I don't mind taking my good time at it…

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_meetIva_phrasesA_2_textMale.txt
file.text: Silence! Milady, what's going on here?

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_meetIva_phrasesA_3_textMale.txt
file.text: We have Prime splashing at our doorstep. It is just as we feared...

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_meetIva_phrasesA_4_textMale.txt
file.text: Milady?! This... This is your Lady?! I—I'm speechless! My Lord has been bamboozled!

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_meetIva_phrasesA_5_textMale.txt
file.text: When I studied at the Academy of Lords, the word "bamboozling" referred to a highly entertaining pastime involving a bamboo reed. Wind Magic, you see, can be used to inflate all manner of blabbermouths. Upon inserting a bamboo pipe into their...

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_meetIva_phrasesA_6_textFemale.txt
file.text: B-b-b-bamboo pipes?! You and your insane Nameless One have tricked me, and my Lady! You shan't get away with it!

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_meetIva_phrasesA_6_textMale.txt
file.text: B-b-b-bamboo pipes?! You and your insane Nameless One have tricked me, and my Lady! You shan't get away with it!

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_meetIva_phrasesA_7_textMale.txt
file.text: We needed help. It isn't wrong to lie when it's a matter of saving someone's life. Drowning in Prime... That would be the true wrong, though it may yet be our fate.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_meetIva_phrasesA_8_textMale.txt
file.text: Don't you go seeing a dragon turd in a flyspeck! The Prime Zone pulsates from time to time. Not often, but it's a well-known phenomena.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_meetIva_phrasesA_9_textMale.txt
file.text: This isn't high tide. This... This is a flood.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_missionIntro_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Oh how my heart soars at these open spaces. Such familiar places. Ah, freedom! I can fly wherever I like! I think I'll just fly—right there!

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_missionIntro_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: There's a shortcut, but it's considerably more dangerous, so we shall have to keep our wits about us.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_missionIntro_phrasesA_2_textMale.txt
file.text: Uh, have you seen the "Nameless One's" common sense around here? I think it might have made a mad dash for the hills...

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_missionIntro_phrasesA_3_textMale.txt
file.text: But I promised my Lady that I would come to her aid as soon as possible.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_missionIntro_phrasesA_4_textMale.txt
file.text: Blah, blah-bitty, blah. You're not the one who makes decisions here. We'll do as my Master instructs.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_PetOwnerHappy_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: Well, guess it takes one to know one…

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_PetOwnerQuestCompleted_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Howl! My friends...Howl! My friends have returned to me. Thank you. Your wish is my command! I shall do whatever you ask.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_PetOwnerQuestCompleted_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: Let's see... I've always wanted a drum kit.—And a cute little bulldog puppy...

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_PetOwnerQuestCompleted_phrasesA_2_textMale.txt
file.text: Quiet. Hagry, take yourself quickly to the outpost. There you will find a young woman named Willow. You must keep her safe.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_PetOwnerQuestCompleted_phrasesA_3_textMale.txt
file.text: Howl! We'll rip those Touched to shreds! My kind of party!

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_PetOwnerQuest_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Howl! My kitty! My puppy! Howl! Why have you forsaken me?

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_PetOwnerQuest_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: Hagry, stop howling. Tell us what has happened.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_PetOwnerQuest_phrasesA_2_textMale.txt
file.text: Howl... I had these friends, you see. A kitty, a puppy, and a little bitty duckie. We were so happy together. Then the Touched came scared my friends into the woods. How will I ever find them again? Howl!

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_PetOwnerQuest_phrasesA_3_textMale.txt
file.text: Howwwwl... I've often noticed that brawn is inversely proportional to brain... Don't worry, you silly giant—we'll find your little ones!

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_PetOwnerQuest_phrasesA_4_textMale.txt
file.text: Howl! If you find them, I will do whatever I can to help you. Howl!

file.text: Don't you lay that on me. I'm not the Nameless One. Besides, we're still looking.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_retreatTroopsOutroWin_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Ah, what luck... From the frying pan into the fire...

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_retreatTroopsOutroWin_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: Fire, you say? It would seem the legends of my hellfire breath have reached even this dank backwater!

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_retreatTroopsOutroWin_phrasesA_2_textMale.txt
file.text: Silence, Babbler! It isn't you he's afraid of. Why are you not at my Lady's side? Answer me, you scum!

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_retreatTroopsOutroWin_phrasesA_3_textMale.txt
file.text: She sent us to find you—for support! We would never have dared abandon her!

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_retreatTroopsOutroWin_phrasesA_4_textMale.txt
file.text: You're lying! Understand this: either you get back to the outpost, or I use your bones to spell the word "DESERTER" upon this very road. Do I make myself clear?

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_secondBorovikEncounter_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: You know what the problem is with these mushrooms? There are just too darn many of them!

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_StartArtefactCharge_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Willow, what artifact are they talking about? Why are we shedding our blood for Prime?

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_StartArtefactCharge_phrasesA_10_textMale.txt
file.text: What are we waiting for? Onward! It's open season on the Touched!

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_StartArtefactCharge_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: A gift from the Prime Zone brought by the Nameless One. A mere fragment of the Old Empire's former glory. But the exact nature of its power remains a mystery.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_StartArtefactCharge_phrasesA_2_textMale.txt
file.text: Hah! You can't impress me with your big words. On the other hand, it does appear that artifact is of some importance to the Touched. Maybe that's the key to all our trouble...

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_StartArtefactCharge_phrasesA_3_textMale.txt
file.text: I do indeed. And I think it might help us do away with the Touched.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_StartArtefactCharge_phrasesA_5_textMale.txt
file.text: I have conducted a few experiments. It is perfectly obvious to me is that the artifact absorbs Prime—to a point. Once it is saturated, an explosion will occur, which will destroy every last speck of Prime in the entire blast area. And if there's no Prime—there's no Touched!

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_StartArtefactCharge_phrasesA_7_textMale.txt
file.text: I'm not sure. I don't think the heroes will like it much, but I believe they'll survive.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_StartArtefactCharge_phrasesA_8_textMale.txt
file.text: My friends! You have no idea how much I enjoy explosions! Let's charge it! Please! Pretty please! Let's blow something up!

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Episode1\dialogs\Dialog_StartArtefactCharge_phrasesA_9_textMale.txt
file.text: We can do it easily enough. The principle is simple—it's the same as charging heroes with Prime. All we need do is kill the Touched, and the artifact will absorb their Prime automatically.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Coop1\Heroes\WitchDoctor\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyA.txt
file.text:
A young zoologist was once famous for his detailed descriptions of the rare and dangerous creatures he found in the Primezone, a turquoise scar left on the face of Praia by the Cataclysm. The scientist was unafraid of monsters and of the Prime anomaly, which was changing nature itself. Many creatures he himself discovered; others he repeatedly observed, though at arm's length. That vicious region had long ago become familiar to him.
But there are creatures in this world far more dangerous than the Touched: humans. An Adornian expeditionary force captured the scientist. The zoologist found himself in captivity, sharing his knowledge to keep himself alive. The other side, after all, always wanted to know everything they could about the Touched. But the prison walls could not hold him for long and he soon escaped.
The scientist wove through the most dangerous areas of the Primezone, hoping his pursuers would lose his trail. In the end, weakened by hunger, the fugitive lost his own way. In the torturous disaster zone, a place it had seemed he knew by heart, he disappeared without a trace. The years of endless wandering drove the scientist to madness, distorting the world in his mind. He learned to control the growth of trees. Bears shared their skins with him and birds and plant roots became his weapons.
For thirty long years, he roamed the Primezone, but he never met a single other person. When he finally made contact with people once more, he found out that, to them, he had only been gone for one year. Scientists suggested that the zoologist had been trapped in a space-time anomaly and welcomed the hero with honor.
For his wisdom and his connection with nature, they consider him a woodsman. But he knows no magic, just much knowledge and experience. The Woodsman's Catalyst, a sprouted cedar seed, proves that he is master of even the most amazing wonders of the forest. Much time has passed and the sprout is still fresh and green.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Coop1\Heroes\WitchDoctor\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyB.txt
file.text:
A hero of the first war with the Dokhts, he was among the last to fight for the Misty Grove. The defeated warrior saw with his own eyes as his hated enemies violated nature with their monstrous machines, disfiguring its beauty and destroying its life.
After the last battle, the Adornian survivors were traveling home, but with difficult. Many of them were wounded and could not move quickly and our hero decided to save some lives. He stayed behind to give his comrades time to escape. But enemy forces cannot be stopped by one warrior, not even one willing to give up his life.
So the soldier called out to nature, asking her for help. He absorbed Prime from the earth, the air and the animals and plants around him...and unleashed on his stunned pursuers all the power of the elements! The giant trees lining the trail bowed their branches and yanked the enemy from their saddles; roots from under their feet cut them to pieces, and birds swooped down on them from the sky. In an instant, the enemy had lost half of its force and the survivors fled.
Weakness overtook the soldier, and he fell to his knees, feeling the remnants of the Prime raging in his bloodstream. His arboreal allies bowed down to him and a mighty oak dropped a ripe acorn at the new hero's feet.
Now, they call him the Witch Doctor, and the giant tree's gift lies in the lord's storehouse along with the catalysts of other heroes. But this friend of the trees is not planning to rest any time soon: a new war has started, which means that the Dokhts will once again begin killing beasts and uprooting forests. Someone must stop them. And who will, if not he?

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Coop1\Heroes\WitchDoctor\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionA.txt
file.text: The Woodsman's attacks do not reveal his location, which makes this hero a great master of the art of ambushes. His enchanted Wicked Tree is a deadly trap for enemy heroes who have foolishly decided to pursue the Witch Doctor. The hero is also protected by his Raging Skin, which he never takes off. The secret of the Woodsman's success lies in using his talents in an effective order to produce a lethal combination.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Coop1\Heroes\Naga\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyA.txt
file.text:
Bizarre creatures that combine a human torso with a snake tail first appeared in the Primezone after a disaster. Dokht scientists believe it was the Cataclysm that gave birth to these four-armed beings, but some of the old-timers recall how even as children they had been frightened by legends of the terrible nagas.
A call of alarm once drove a young naga away from his native tribe. He turned up soon in the lands of the tailless, those who have conquered metal, stone, and Prime. It was there that he saw people with such unbelievable skills in battle that he was immediately consumed with a desire to cross all four of his swords with them.
He slithered to the gladiator arena where restless fighters longed for battle and, to the joy of the spectators, bled out their souls in duels. Then he issued a challenge to all of the heroes there. Those present were shaken by the warrior's impudence and fearlessness; some even thought the challenge was a joke. But the snake-man insisted so vehemently that four enraged Dokht heroes stepped onto the sand, which had absorbed the Prime of past duels.
Legends of that battle continue to be told to this day. Indeed, the naga could not be conquered. He survived and even seriously wounded all of his opponents. The lords sitting among the spectators eagerly invited the hero to join their armed forces, but the naga remained in the arena—his only interests at the time were battle and triumph.
The snake-man gained great fame over the years of close fighting. In time, the four-armed hero's appears ceased to be strange to the Dokhts. More and more nagas appeared in the cities of the Imperium. Surprisingly, heroes were often born among their tribes.
When the war began, all naga warriors received orders to appear at the front. Not one failed to present himself: handing over to the lords their carefully preserved Catalysts—ivory amulets for coming of age—the four-armed warriors were sent into the very center of the hottest battles.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Coop1\Heroes\Naga\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyB.txt
file.text:
They say there are no better masters of fencing on Prime than the four-armed magicians of the sword, the nagas. But it's not only physical features and talent that give the victory to a soldier. Tenacity is the greatest virtue. It causes even the most powerful opponent to capitulate.
In his youth, this future hero saw how the naga fights aggressively like a pack of wolves; one of the Dokht gamekeepers wanted to hunt down the snake-man, but he failed. The fantastic mastery of swords shocked the boy, and he swore he would become a disciple of the blades. He trained extensively, and by his twentieth birthday he had transformed into a skillful warrior. Desiring to prove himself, the young fighter headed for the wood of the nagas and challenged their best swordsman to a duel.
He lost. With great solemnity, the snake-men buried the brave man's slashed body, but he insolently returned as a hero. Handing his Catalyst over to a lord, he negotiated rather unusual conditions of service. Then he returned to the nagas, desiring to cross swords with their champion. He fell in battle once again, but being restored to life, he swore he would never stop trying until he won the victory.
The lord, who had to bring the fallen hero back from the dead time and again, once mentioned him at a highbrow dinner party. Lady Iness, who owned the Hall of Peace at the time, was at the reception. Considered the best in the kingdom at the art of resuscitation, she was stunned when she heard of swordsman's tenacity. She composed a special Song of Return for her fellow lord. The next time the hero died, he was reborn in the form of a naga, allowing him to gain his long-awaited victory.
This technique of transforming human heroes into nagas later became known to other skillful lords. A multitude of famous swordsmen resolved to change their appearance to become as Sesha and, in the new war, to fight against the Imperium with four blades at once.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Coop1\Heroes\Naga\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionA.txt
file.text: The Blade Master's unsurpassed flexibility allows him to break into the thick of battle with a single quick charge and easily dodge most of the enemy's attacks. This many-armed warrior is capable of attacking multiple nearby enemies with his enchanted blades. Paralyzing poison reduces his opponents' combat effectiveness, while the Blade Master's hypnotic talents distract them, protecting allies who have poor defensive abilities.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Coop1\Heroes\ManaWyrm\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyA.txt
file.text:
Arcane Wyrms are not very sociable, and besides, not many people are willing to converse with flying snakes; no one knows their many secrets. Where did they come from? Where did they grow up? How did they become heroes?
Some lovers of mysteries and riddles tell stories of an ancient tribe of these wonderful creatures. Others say that the Arcane Wyrms are a result of mutations, a consequence of the uncontrolled resurrections of the first heroes. Still others talk about the deliberate transformation of a brilliant scientist who yearned for special powers. But some mention the absurd randomness of this new, developing technology. Of course, some just argue that these creatures are specimens of the Touched.
This particular scaled giant appeared among the Dokhts during the bloody War for the Misty Grove and offered his services to the most powerful lord. His superhuman abilities are helpful for any force, and the Imperium warmly welcomed the strange visitor, even though the technocrats have long distrusted magic. But denying the magical essence of the Arcane Wyrm was impossible; even the high-browed wise men from the capital's Academy came to marvel at the hero's abilities.
Their interests were mutual. The horned snake was not adverse to studying his allies, and the explosive developments in the new society seems good food for thought. The Arcane Wyrm argues that human potential is greatest in the art of warfare. Perhaps he participates in war only to learn more about these soft-bodied, two-legged creatures who are yet so aggressive, uncompromising, and...human.
The Arcane Wyrm's catalyst is a piece of his own shell, chipped by the Prime bullet that marked the creature's first encounter with humans. Fortunately, the Arcane Wyrm had enough sense not to show aggression, and the archers had the sense to conquer their fears and respond appropriately to the unusual creature's greeting.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Coop1\Heroes\ManaWyrm\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyB.txt
file.text:
The great guru of Prime-an-gao" preached leisure and tranquility of life, filled not only with simple pleasures but with admiration of the sublime, the contemplation of perfection and of the spiritual unity of all things.
He avoided crowds. This philosopher of luxury appreciated, more than anything else, the comfort of mind he found in solitude, when thoughts flowed gently and pen and ink were always ready to record the next wonderful concept. Only a few trusted students could fully understand his complex philosophical constructs, but the clarity and depth of his phrases captivated even the most sophisticated connoisseurs of literature, and ordinary readers were attracted by his easygoing sense of humor and the amazing accuracy of his observations. Soon, it became Adornian fashion to read the treatises, philosophical writings, and contemplative exercises of Prime-an-gao.
The Call of the Prime did not worry the Teacher too much. He took full responsibility for any changes: he rubbed the magical substance all over his body, then burnt it in his room, like incense. Then, when the air shimmered with a bluish glow, he poured the substance into a hookah and smoked it with his pipe. The guru wanted to achieve maximum union with the Prime.
And he did. The great teacher became a hero, but his soul was not the only thing to change: his flesh changed in the most remarkable way!
The guru became a Dragonfly, a magical lizard of legend, and only his pipe, which he kept as a Catalyst, suggests that, inside, he is still the same: wise, cheerful, and prone to conversation and debate. Even in battle, he remains himself. And when his fellow heroes ask why he went to war, Dragonfly grins with the corners of his snake-like jaws and cheerfully hisses: "Prime-an-gao directed me here".

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Coop1\Heroes\ManaWyrm\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionA.txt
file.text: The Arcane Wyrm is a physically weak creature, but thanks to his Ethereal Shield, he can absorb damage with his Energy. His deadly magic entangles enemy heroes with an arcane web, weakens their wills, and outright kills the faint of heart. This hero is very dependent on its Energy, but it can quickly restore that Energy by assuming its Ethereal Form and coming into contact with living beings. The Arcane Wyrm's victory depends on balancing attack and defense and knowing when to retreat.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Coop1\Heroes\Hunter\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyA.txt
file.text:
The Keepers did not know his real name, and very few have ever seen the Marksman up close. Any encounter with the Marksman was very brief: a dashing horseman suddenly appeared, skewered his target with an arrow, and vanished.
He studied for years to achieve his archery skills. Even after he became a master, he never ceased to practice, always striving for absolute perfection. His motto was “You can always do better,” a truth understood by his beloved, well-trained horse. The loyal steed could read even the briefest glances from the hero and was always a faithful comrade and friend. The rider never used spurs or straps, and his horse's bridle was only for show.
The Marksman's enemies dreamed of his destruction. A great bounty had been put on his head, but even the kingdom's heroes were unable to capture him until the skilled mage they called Sorcerer stepped in. The Keepers spread a rumor of a caravan of Imperium captives about to head off to Egisar. Immediately, the Marksman saddled up his trusted Greymane and rushed to intercept the caravan. But the line of chained slaves and the guards escorting them were only a mirage. The clever Sorcerer had created an illusion, and the best archer in the Imperium flew towards the trap at a full gallop. A bottomless quagmire full of poisonous Prime fumes enveloped the great warrior. The enemies could not defeat him by force, but they won by their cunning. The Sorcerer received his well-deserved reward.
But the Marksman was not dead. The Spell Trap, covered in Prime, changed him terribly, binding him to his dear horse. After a full day in the fetid swamp, he escaped, a mighty centaur filled with sorrow, hatred, and a thirst for vengeance.
In memory of his dear friend, the Marksman kept his horse's old bridle as a Catalyst. It constantly reminds him of his loss—and of those who are to blame. A fury approaching madness rules the hero on the battlefield, but when he shoots, he never misses.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Coop1\Heroes\Hunter\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyB.txt
file.text:
Many years ago, among the wild forests and fertile pastures which are now the domain of the Keepers of Adornia, tribes of centaurs ruled the land. The marksmen and hunters were friends not only with humans but also with the suspicious unicorns.
But the growing Empire of Alexander drove out and slaughtered many of the creatures, even entire tribes and nations. The centaurs fled to an island in the Angry Ocean. Only many years after the cataclysm did the young and graceful Hunter come to the borders of the Primezone. He was perhaps the last of his kind, the final member of the ancient, freedom-loving creatures.
A superb trapper, he supplied the Keepers with fur and meat, but he failed to understand the meaning of borders and the hostility of the Imperium. “Hunters should just try to get enough to feed themselves and their families, but people are always taking more than they need,” the centaur complained. He was warned, but he disregarded the advice and crossed the border into the Imperium, going wherever he wished.
The Dokhts repeatedly attempted to capture him, but he always escaped, so a party of angry guards organized a hunt for him, as if he were a wild beast. With Prime guns, they surrounded the Hunter, demanding that he surrender. Their demands were met only with arrows, but the battle was not evenly matched. The Dokhts threw the centaur's twisted corpse to the mercy of the Primezone's monsters.
But, in the magical vapors of the Prime, the centaur was reborn a hero. He saved the bullet from his mortal wound and made it his Catalyst. The Hunter took an oath of service to the Keepers, or, more precisely, to the lord, who sends him into battle and lets him kill as many Dokhts as he can. After all, as long as there are enemies in world, there are borders, and until the end of these, the world will not see lasting peace.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Coop1\Heroes\Fairy\_A.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyA.txt
file.text:
The girl's father was an unrecognized genius: all of his inventions had been out of place and time. He decided to make her daughter's fantasies a reality. The townsfolk and his colleagues laughed at him, but he stubbornly kept up his work. And that's how he died, in the prime of his life: misunderstood, ridiculed, and unneeded..
Analyzing the things in her father's library after his funeral, the girl found drawings of a flying apparatus, powered by a Prime engine. A resolution of the mechanics' workshops had judged the design: it would not fly. But despite all of that, the inventor's daughter decided to complete her father's work and prove his genius. When the helicopter unit was ready, the girl went up to the top of the belfry, put it on, fastened the belts, spun the blades, and, ignoring the cries of surprise and horror from below, stepped out into the void.
Analyzing the things in her father's library after his funeral, the girl found drawings of a flying apparatus, powered by a Prime engine. A resolution of the mechanics' workshops had judged the design: it would not fly. But despite all of that, the inventor's daughter decided to complete her father's work and prove his genius. When the helicopter unit was ready, the girl went up to the top of the belfry, put it on, fastened the belts, spun the blades, and, ignoring the cries of surprise and horror from below, stepped out into the void.
The joy of the flight, the fulfilment of the dreams which had captivated her for years, turned her into a hero. The awkward somersaults were soon replaced by confident and smooth turns. Suddenly, the air around her filled with fairies, and they adopted her as their leader, mimicking her every move. The girl realized that her childhood dream had come true.
Later, a special commission concluded that the flying apparatus was able to lift a modest weight into the air; however, only a hero could reliably control it. Naturally, these developments did not go unnoticed by the Imperium's armed forces. As soon as the war started, miniature girl-heroes with flying apparatuses bravely went off to the front.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Coop1\Heroes\Fairy\_A.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyB.txt
file.text:
Driven by the king's ransom offered them, Dokht smugglers kidnapped the Adornian lady's young pupil and hid with her in the Primezone. The best trackers returned empty-handed. The villains had vanished in the mists of the dangerous lands along the border.
Losing their way, the smugglers were themselves lost. The party wandered into the dwelling place of the winged Touched, named so by fairies in memory of the long-gone era of fairy tales. Though they were usually kind to all living creatures, the winged creatures suddenly went into a frenzy. Perhaps the fairies saw something unusual in the girl's heart, something familiar. They ambushed the smugglers and chased them out of their territory, forcing them to release their helpless prisoner.
Realizing that she could never find her way home, the girl stayed with the fairies. The place where they lived was not troubled by Touched predators and was filled with plenty of sweet flower nectar, which the girl soon learned to love. Soon the girl realized that the silly fairies were unwittingly fulfilling the unspoken desires she had had since she was a child. The girl began to feel herself change: wings grew on her back, and she started to experience the strange powers of her flying friends.
One day, the girl heard the noise of a battle nearby. On the road to Fairy Valley, an Adornian party struggled with a huge Touched fungus creature. Suddenly, a familiar coat of arms appeared from the trees. The lady's heroes had found the girl! The young girl called the fairies to her aid and joined the battle. She hung a spectral silhouette over the heroes' heads, and the fairies surrounded them, creating a protective cocoon of “winged flowers.” Others flew at the monster, preventing him from crushing the heroes.
The heroes triumphed, but only thanks to the help of the girl and her fairies. After the festivities in her honor had concluded, the lasy listened attentively to the girl's story. Soon, the Adornian lords learned how to create similar heros, with the help of nectar from Prime flowers.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Coop1\Heroes\Fairy\_A.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionA.txt
file.text: Fay is a great support hero. By sending her fairies into the battle, she can attack enemies and protect allies. She can bring the wrath of her miniature helpers to bear at the crucial moment in the fight, causing significant damage to all nearby enemies. Her unique ability to unite with other heroes allows her to become invincible for a time. By doing this, Fay cannot only avoid danger but also increase an allied hero's combat abilities or hinder an enemy's.

Realizing that she could never find her way home, the girl stayed with the fairies. The place where they lived was not troubled by Touched predators and was filled with plenty of sweet flower nectar, which the girl soon learned to love. Soon the girl realized that the silly fairies were unwittingly fulfilling the unspoken desires she had had since she was a child. The girl began to feel herself change: wings grew on her back, and she started to experience the strange powers of her flying friends.
One day, the girl heard the noise of a battle nearby. On the road to Fairy Valley, an Adornian party struggled with a huge Touched fungus creature. Suddenly, a familiar coat of arms appeared from the trees. The lady's heroes had found the girl! The young girl called the fairies to her aid and joined the battle. She hung a spectral silhouette over the heroes' heads, and the fairies surrounded them, creating a protective cocoon of “winged flowers.” Others flew at the monster, preventing him from crushing the heroes.
The heroes triumphed, but only thanks to the help of the girl and her fairies. After the festivities in her honor had concluded, the lasy listened attentively to the girl's story. Soon, the Adornian lords learned how to create similar heros, with the help of nectar from Prime flowers.

file.name: Maps\PvE\Series\Coop1\Heroes\Fairy\_B.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionA.txt
file.text: Fay is a great support hero. By sending her fairies into the battle, she can attack enemies and protect allies. She can bring the wrath of her miniature helpers to bear at the crucial moment in the fight, causing significant damage to all nearby enemies. Her unique ability to unite with other heroes allows her to become invincible for a time. By doing this, Fay cannot only avoid danger but also increase an allied hero's combat abilities or hinder an enemy's.

file.text: \tThe Lord is a cruel and talented strategist who is unused to sitting it out in the rear. Under his command, soldiers have confidently marched to their death for the sake of victory, and now their swords have been summoned to service again.\r\n\tWith combat construction, the hero diverts enemy attacks back against them and moves across the battlefield in a wave of blades, turning even the direst of situations to advantage with sound tactical decisions.

file.name: Heroes\Witcher\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyA.txt
file.text:
Wanderers. Pilgrims. Pathfinders.
These gruff warriorss can often be found haunting taverns in the small settlements that dot the periphery of the Prime Zone. Solitary and taciturn, they know the many paths that wend their way through that dangerous territory, but seldom are they willing to share their knowledge with others. Thanks to the innumerable treasures it holds, the Prime Zone has no love for uninvited guests.
Only one story is gladly told there: the tale of the first Wanderer. He was serving as the first falconer of a minor lord when a grave disaster struck the village. One night a horde of the Touched emerged from a neighboring forest. Hideous satyrs and ravenous sirens attacked the peasants, and the small contingent of local guards was powerless to stop them. At the head of the horde stood a terrible Amanita, a giant covered in moss and mold, wielding a tree ripped up by the roots as a club.
The falconer fought alongside the guardsmen, but he knew that the battle was hopeless. That was when destiny brought him face to face with the horde's leader. The falconer dodged a blow from the great club and plunged his sword into the monster's breast. The brave warrior was covered from head to toe in blood steeped in prime, and it awoke the power of the hero within him. The Amanita fell, and the attacking Touched flew in terror without their leader.
Many of the peasants were so desperate that they forgot the danger before them and, inspired by the Wanderer's example, threw themselves upon the Touched battlemasters. A few of them survived, and so the ranks of the Wanderers grew.
They left their catalysts with their lords and swore an oath to come to their aid in times of great danger. And so they disappeared into the ruins of the Prime Zone, hoping to make their way further into the depths of the cursed forest and prevent future attacks on local villages. For the hero's true duty lies not in satisfying the whims of lords, but in serving the people—both Dokhts and Adornians.
But when war broke out, the Wanderers began to return to their lords to keep their vows and aid them in their quest for victory.

file.name: Heroes\Witcher\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionA.txt
file.text: \tThe Wanderer is the most reliable bodyguard. He never fails to come to his allies' aid, protecting them vigorously by taking damage in their place. This hero resolutely attacks enemies, forcing them to battle with him.\r\n\tEach blow of the enemy only makes the Wanderer more bold and powerful. Thus the Wanderer never retreats, as long as his sword of justice thirsts for vengeance.
