file.name: Heroes\Hunter\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyA.txt
file.text:
The Keepers did not know his real name, and very few have ever seen the Marksman up close. Any encounter with the Marksman was very brief: a dashing horseman suddenly appeared, skewered his target with an arrow, and vanished.
He studied for years to achieve his archery skills. Even after he became a master, he never ceased to practice, always striving for absolute perfection. His motto was “You can always do better,” a truth understood by his beloved, well-trained horse. The loyal steed could read even the briefest glances from the hero and was always a faithful comrade and friend. The rider never used spurs or straps, and his horse's bridle was only for show.
The Marksman's enemies dreamed of his destruction. A great bounty had been put on his head, but even the kingdom's heroes were unable to capture him until the skilled mage they called Sorcerer stepped in. The Keepers spread a rumor of a caravan of Imperium captives about to head off to Egisar. Immediately, the Marksman saddled up his trusted Greymane and rushed to intercept the caravan. But the line of chained slaves and the guards escorting them were only a mirage. The clever Sorcerer had created an illusion, and the best archer in the Imperium flew towards the trap at a full gallop. A bottomless quagmire full of poisonous Prime fumes enveloped the great warrior. The enemies could not defeat him by force, but they won by their cunning. The Sorcerer received his well-deserved reward.
But the Marksman was not dead. The Spell Trap, covered in Prime, changed him terribly, binding him to his dear horse. After a full day in the fetid swamp, he escaped, a mighty centaur filled with sorrow, hatred, and a thirst for vengeance.
In memory of his dear friend, the Marksman kept his horse's old bridle as a Catalyst. It constantly reminds him of his loss—and of those who are to blame. A fury approaching madness rules the hero on the battlefield, but when he shoots, he never misses.

file.name: Heroes\Hunter\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyB.txt
file.text:
Many years ago, among the wild forests and fertile pastures which are now the domain of the Keepers of Adornia, tribes of centaurs ruled the land. The marksmen and hunters were friends not only with humans but also with the suspicious unicorns.
But the growing Empire of Alexander drove out and slaughtered many of the creatures, even entire tribes and nations. The centaurs fled to an island in the Angry Ocean. Only many years after the cataclysm did the young and graceful Hunter come to the borders of the Primezone. He was perhaps the last of his kind, the final member of the ancient, freedom-loving creatures.
A superb trapper, he supplied the Keepers with fur and meat, but he failed to understand the meaning of borders and the hostility of the Imperium. “Hunters should just try to get enough to feed themselves and their families, but people are always taking more than they need,” the centaur complained. He was warned, but he disregarded the advice and crossed the border into the Imperium, going wherever he wished.
The Dokhts repeatedly attempted to capture him, but he always escaped, so a party of angry guards organized a hunt for him, as if he were a wild beast. With Prime guns, they surrounded the Hunter, demanding that he surrender. Their demands were met only with arrows, but the battle was not evenly matched. The Dokhts threw the centaur's twisted corpse to the mercy of the Primezone's monsters.
But, in the magical vapors of the Prime, the centaur was reborn a hero. He saved the bullet from his mortal wound and made it his Catalyst. The Hunter took an oath of service to the Keepers, or, more precisely, to the lord, who sends him into battle and lets him kill as many Dokhts as he can. After all, as long as there are enemies in world, there are borders, and until the end of these, the world will not see lasting peace.

file.name: Heroes\Hunter\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionA.txt
file.text: \tThe Marksman's accurate shooting and jagged arrowheads inflict bleeding wounds on his enemies. His enchanted arrows fly incredibly far and mortally wound his opponents.\r\n\tHis magic horn encourages his side to attack the enemy and the rage of the hunt grants him truly fearsome speed and agility. The Marksman's bow is a serious challenge to any opponent. Drawing it to its limit, the hero releases an arrow which devastates everything in its path.

file.name: Heroes\Hunter\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionB.txt
file.text: \tThe Hunter's accurate shooting and jagged arrowheads inflict bleeding wounds on his enemies. The Hunter's bow is a serious challenge to any opponent. Drawing it to its limit, the hero releases an arrow which devastates everything in its path.

file.name: Heroes\Highlander\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyA.txt
file.text:
In the ancient chronicles, one can read the beautiful tale of the Seeing Swords, weapons only the most powerful and courageous warriors could wield. Their blades were indestructible and enchanted with unique personalities selected by their owners. The weapons' strength matched the skill of their bearers. These great heroes of the past were reportedly invincible.
But time erases the memory of even the greatest feats. For many years, no one has spoken of the “living” swords, and the secret of their origin has remained a mystery.
And yet the unusual weapons returned to the people: just before the start of the war, a mighty warrior descended from the mountains, armed with one of the Seeing Swords. The broad-shouldered, fire-haired giant would not give his name but claimed that he was born of an ancient mountain clan.
The Highlander gave his catalyst to the lord: a whetstone, with which he lovingly smooths his sword during the rare times of respite between battles, discussing his slain enemies with his beloved weapon. The warrior speaks more with his sword than with other people, and only by piecing together some scattered hints can his story be determined. The bearer of another Seeing Sword entered Highlander's home at night and summoned to battle the head of the family, keeper of the ancient weapon. By the time the guards arrived, the battle was over and the intruder had fled.
The Highlander's father lay mortally wounded. He died in his son's arms and the boy took up his father's sword and swore to track down the killer. Now vengeance will ever be on the edge of his sword, until it is sated with the blood of that vile murderer.

file.name: Heroes\Highlander\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyB.txt
file.text:
No one who lives today knew him in his youth. Anyone you ask will answer, with a shrug, that the Immortal one has always been just like he is now. He does not change and does not age and always carries his faithful sword, All-Seeing Steel.
Rumor has it that they met many years ago and have since become dependent on one another. But who is dependent on whom? Behind the hero's back, people whisper that he has long been kept under the blade's control, acting only to fulfill its strange commands.
One day, the hero was invited to participate in the Spring Flowers celebration, along with the other masters of war. He was blindfolded and some rag dolls and obstacles were placed around him, but when the signal sounded, the sword would not leave its sheath! The noble weapon, desiring to drink the life of vanquished enemies, did not want to participate in such silly games and the hero left the festival amidst laughter and shouts of ridicule. The apprentice of the local master laughed most of all. But as he mocked, the ridiculed warrior summoned him to a bloody duel. Now the sword had no trouble leaving its sheath. In a matter of seconds, it had knocked away the mocker's weapon and torn his flesh to pieces. Then, it returned to its resting place, awaiting its next feast of blood.
All-Seeing Steel leads the hero in battle. It was made for war and victory, not for peaceful entertainment. Only in battle is its deadly power revealed. The blade does not like the long pauses between fights, always yearning to face another round of perilous enemies.

file.name: Heroes\Highlander\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionA.txt
file.text: \tThe Highlander is famous for his contempt for pain and death. He wields his sword masterfully, becoming a whirlwind of steel which destroys forces of enemy soldiers and disarms enemy heroes.\r\n\tEvery one of the Highlander' blows accelerates his attacks; every death of one of his foes restores his Strength. And even if the hero falls, his immortal spirit will revive him.

file.name: Heroes\Highlander\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionB.txt
file.text: \tImmortal is famous for his contempt for pain and death. He wields his sword masterfully, becoming a whirlwind of steel which destroys forces of enemy soldiers and disarms enemy heroes.\r\n\tEvery one of Immortal's blows accelerates his attacks; every death of one of his foes restores his Strength. And even if the hero falls, his immortal spirit will revive him.

file.name: Heroes\Healer\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyA.txt
file.text:
For forty hours a week, she gave shots and applied compresses. She was strict, but her deeds helped her patients, and no one could argue with that. She nursed the most helpless and hopeless, poor souls on whom even the most experienced doctors had given up. Sometimes, though, this mediocre life bored her. She would often pace around her room, dreaming of greater things.
Be careful what you wish for. For one day, a raid by the Keepers turned the quiet hospital into a massive bonfire. She awoke stunned, overwhelmed by the pleas for help, the collapsing walls, the unbearable smoke and heat of the fire. “Save yourself!” the staff screamed, “Run!” But she would not leave the patients to die. “Go ahead and run!” she yelled back as she dashed into the burning building. She began to pull her patients and colleagues out of the fire, undaunted by the burning beams all around, unafraid of the soot and the smoke. The difficulty of the struggle only fed her resolve. She resuscitated those who had stopped breathing, quickly treated the worst wounds, and dragged patients out of danger.
When the last patient she had rescued was safe, she realized her calling. The Healer joined the war effort, a place where her abilities were sorely needed.

file.name: Heroes\Healer\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyB.txt
file.text:
From her childhood, the noble lord spoiled his daughter. To his delight, she grew up into a rare beauty, and one who knew the benefits of her appearance. She so conducted herself that all around her jumped to fulfill her every whim.
None of the tournaments lacked her involvement. Men performed many miracles of heroism for her and would give their lives for her if necessary. Once, as they fought for her attention, some warriors mortally wounded each other. The girl was stunned by the sight. Giving in to a sudden urge, the girl leapt into the arena and shouted loudly: "Do not die! Look at me! I order you not to die!"
The spectators marveled as the soldiers stood up, their mortal wounds healed, their faces full of amazement at their salvation. It was the sweetest feeling they had ever had! The girl was flattered that men were willing to die for her, but even more pleased that she could save their lives. That was true beauty: saving the lives of gallant warriors! She would do this for the rest of her life!

file.name: Heroes\Healer\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionA.txt
file.text: \tThis hero does not spend her time destroying enemies. Instead, all of her talents focus on healing her allies and increasing their strength and defense.\r\n\tThe hero can heal multiple allies at once, enabling allied soldiers to storm the enemy more effectively. But it is in the most decisive battles that the Healer truly shines, saving allies on her team from the brink of death.

file.name: Heroes\Gunslinger\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionA.txt
file.text: \tDesperado tirelessly wreaks havoc on his enemies with his red-hot pistols, boosting the strength and speed of his attacks as well as his Rage, enhancing his own abilities, and healing himself.\r\n\tMark of the Hunter prevents the enemy from escaping without taking damage, and Survival Instinct lets this hero escape danger by crippling his pursuers.

file.text: \tNot everyone can handle Cannoneer's explosive nature. Hero's shotgun fires rarely, but aptly, and the Hero himself will always find a couple of tricks against any enemy. Cannoneer can be taken by surprise, but by shooting shrapnel back at the foes, he will set their eyebrows on fire.\r\n\tThe Hero is also dangerous in close combat: high-angle fire from a mortar poses a serious threat from above, hitting random enemies at a great distance from the Hero.

file.name: Heroes\GhostLord\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyA.txt
file.text:
The Prime conceals many secrets. Its properties are amazing, but its effects are unpredictable and often deadly. The Keepers believe that the substance is somehow magical, but the Dokhts, accustomed to only believing hard facts, are constantly trying to get at the truth behind the nature of the Prime.
The Soul Reaper was once the captain of an elite unit that provided security for the Imperium's secret investigations. The detachment had never lost a single man; the commander's vast experience saved his men many times. But even a professional cannot be certain of the outcome when dealing with something as unpredictable as the Prime.
The team was sent to investigate an unusual anomaly in the heart of the Primezone. The soldiers had cordoned the area off, and the scientists had begun to set up their equipment, when the commander sensed danger, raised the alarm, and began to evacuate the surprised scientific staff from the danger zone. But all of his efforts were in vain. The most powerful explosion any of them had ever seen tore through the team, and all of them disappeared in a violent gush of Prime.
The captain regained consciousness during the night, a lone commander without an army. The pain of loss that the hero felt was unbearably intense. All of his comrades had perished in the deadly explosion. Only a piece of copper remained: the soldiers' medallions, melted into a single shapeless bar. In memory of the dead, the captain made the copper bar his Catalyst and used the Prime to burn a cross on his chest.
The scientists were amazed at the new hero's incredible abilities, but he does not feel himself to be unique. The Reaper is tormented by guilt for the deaths of his friends. By subjugating the ghosts of slain enemies in battle, he attempts to use them to communicate with the spirits of his comrades. The Reaper dreams of one day hearing the rustle of their voices and gaining his chance to apologize to them.

file.name: Heroes\GhostLord\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyB.txt
file.text:
No ordinary mortal, not even the greatest magician, can know what lies beyond this earthly life. Only heroes know what it is to die and be reborn. But whenever something falls outside of the power of man, there are always some who feel the urge to try and control it.
This powerful wizard, an expert in the magic of the Prime, dreamed of finding inspiration in death. He dreamed of knowing and experiencing his own existence both in life and in the afterlife. Evil men claim that he sometimes used the souls of living people in his rituals, and for that, he is called the Soul Catcher. Perhaps the chilling rumors had some truth to them. He was like a man obsessed, treating others like an artist treats his paints. But he did not wish to act cruelly, and once he found the right path, he took it immediately.
He managed to accomplish the impossible, opening a passage into the other world. The Soul Catcher stepped in, without hesitation, and disappeared from our world. When he returned, after many long years, his eyes sparkled with an unknown light, and on his shoulder, he carried a scythe of death. The great mage understood the essence of life and the destruction of death, and was able to master them both. His abilities of subduing the spirits of the dead and handling life Energy itself are awe-inspiring, and even the lord he serves is too afraid to touch his Catalyst, a burning, glowing, ghastly sphere from the other world.
Perhaps the Soul Catcher had to give much of himself to visit the other world, but he also gained much. After learning what lies at the end of the road of Death, he turned back, returning to the road of Life. Realizing his new talents could be used in battle, he spends most of his time helping his allies, not destroying his enemies.

file.name: Heroes\GhostLord\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionA.txt
file.text: \tThe mere presence of the Soul Reaper on the battlefield compels the dead to return to fight under his leadership. The Shield of Ghosts can protect anyone the Reaper chooses, and his ghostly whip lets him drain the enemy's life force and channel it into one of his allies.\r\n\tHe can raise an army of ghosts with terrible blows from his scythe and, becoming the ghost of death himself, direct their wrath at his remaining opponents.

file.name: Heroes\GhostLord\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionB.txt
file.text: \tThe mere presence of the Soul Catcher on the battlefield compels the dead to return to fight under his leadership. file.name: Heroes\Frogenglut\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyA.txt
file.text:
It was fall, winter even, but work at the milling machine was torturing the young fellow. He cursed it all, insulted the foreman, and left to travel wherever he wished. And ended up in a laboratory researching the Touched. In the laboratory, the kind eyes of a well-fed HUGE POISONOUS FROG looked out at him from its luxurious heated cage. The two immediately became friends. Inseparable friends.
Everything was fine. The young man would clean the tank and conduct some harmless experiments. But then, a gang of rough Adornian teens broke into the city. They overturned urns, smashed windows, and caused a general ruckus. It so happened that an accurately thrown stone found its mark in our hero, who was trying to protect the laboratory from the hooligans. Well, he wasn't a hero quite yet, but almost.
The frog came and stood over his fallen friend. It washed him with crocodile tears, borrowed from a nearby aquarium. And poked him with his tooth. Yes, we know that frogs don't have teeth, but all kinds of things go on in secret laboratories!
And the brave young lad became a hero. He jumped onto the frog, as if onto a war horse, and they suffocated their enemies. Well, not completely—there were kids there, after all—but they choked them enough to teach them a good lesson. They saved the city, defended their homes, and drove the enemies away.
Since that day, the two have been inseparable. But not long ago, the frog began to miss his birthplace: the Weeping Sun Valley, located in the middle of the Kingdom of Adornia. And to get there, the Dokhts need to win the war first! So, they fight. For a good cause.

file.name: Heroes\Frogenglut\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyB.txt
file.text:
So, what's the Swamp King like? I'll tell you about us... I and my twin brother lived together, studying magic. Successfully, too: we could make the whole of Adornia thunder! What? You haven't heard of us? Well, my brother's a...tadpole from a different pool, you know. Well, actually, the Angry Ocean!
What in the world are you talking about, brother? Ribbit! You must understand, sometimes we try too hard to have a sense of humor, like our mother taught us! Well, I'm the toad, and this here is my brother, the rider. Ribbit! One day I gave my brother some green tea spiked with Prime. But he switched drinks on me... And look at the results: all green and warty!
Don't interrupt! Things have worked out alright. Now we're heroes. Our old broken wands are our Catalyst. We were resurrected, together. Perhaps our heroic duality is because of our twin...am I having trouble expressing myself? Anyway, not all is lost! We've been raised and we're a pair now... And so we fight. One of us leaping, the other riding.
By the way, these enemy heroes are tastier than flies! Well, one of use jumps around... while the other swings his ax! And during battle, we might get something we need from an enemy, an ingredient... we've already come up with a ritual to get rid of this curse. Of course, we've got nothing to complain about now, but we'll still be heroes without this toad curse, so why not get rid of it? Ribbit!

file.name: Heroes\Frogenglut\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionA.txt
file.text: \tThe Frog Whisperer always relies on his ravenous "steed." The toad catches delicious enemies with his long tongue and eats them, growing in size and appetite! The toad loves to jump—and the bigger it grows, the more deadly its crushing leaps become.\r\n\tIf someone dares to offend the Frog Whisperer's best friend, a throw of his battle ax will put a stop to the insolent fool.

file.text: \tDon't expect a warm welcome from Freeze — this hero can pursue his prey with Frigid Onslaught, capture them in a Ring of Needles, and work them over with Icy Blows — all without even stopping!\r\n\tAnd, if the victim thinks they're out of range of Brood of Ice, a mighty fist rises out of the ground and shows them their mistake, knocking the enemy right into the icy face of death!

file.name: Heroes\Fluffy\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyA.txt
file.text:
He was a spiteful, unrestrained scoffer who was skeptical about some Dokht research, openly critical of what he considers pseudoscience. As a result, he was thrown into prison, where eternal darkness reigns. He quickly lost count of the passing days, but what irritated him the most was the silence. He himself could never stay quiet, and he hated the lack of background noise.
To keep himself from going mad, he began whistling a simple melody. The unusual sound attracted the prison rats, and they began to give the jokester company. He fashioned a simple flute from a piece of copper pipe, and was surprised to see more and more long-tailed guests show up with each new melody he played. The flute fascinated the rodents, and they submitted to the man’s music like good soldiers to their general’s orders.
He spent many long days learning how to direct his army, and at long last made them gnaw through the bars of his cell. The prisoner escaped to freedom, his gray army going with him. The rats became his hands, his ears, and even his eyes, since he could not adjust to the light at first.
He could not abide the thought of returning to prison, so to avoid being hunted, he decided to enter the military and serve his lord on the field. At first he was not taken seriously – what good is a rat piper in battle? Stealing a few coins? Nibbling some banners? But the Dokhts value any skill, so the lord’s job was to find a use for it. It soon became clear that the man’s homemade pipe could control the will not only of rats but of men as well. And just like that, flutist in sunglasses became a welcome addition to any military campaign. Though called the Pied Piper, he’s often nicknamed the ratcatcher, but he swears he has never, ever hurt his little rodent helpers.

file.name: Heroes\Fluffy\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyB.txt
file.text:
He could spend hours contemplating the flitting butterflies or the dancing leaves, admiring the harmony and beauty of each. This passionate musician knew how to turn sounds into magic, even the rhythm of his steps as he walked. He sewed little bells into his hat, and they sounded an intricate melody as he strode along. Then came the Call of the Prime, but he was committed to his music.
However, human ears could not discern the real nuances of his shimmering melodies. Only the rats could perceive them, and they began to follow the flutist everywhere. “How can you stand being near those disgusting creatures?” the ignorant people asked. “You don’t understand them,” he said. “But I will make you appreciate the beauty of my music, and then you will empathize with my little gray friends!”
With that, the musician went into voluntary exile. He played in deserted areas, and his rats cared for him, finding food for him and shelter when needed. Weeks passed, but his suffering was no closer to ending – until the rodents brought him a pearl of Prime. The musician realized how hard his little friends must have worked to get it, and so he took its arrival as a sign and accepted the Prime. When he took up his flute once more, it was to play a whole new tune.
Now his music could enchant humans, too, submitting them to his will by making them see the world as the virtuoso does. His fans soon numbered in the thousands. But no hero can be truly free in times of war. Spectators began casting sidelong glances at him, murmuring about how much his talents would help in battle against the enemy. Lords insisted more and more that he join their forces. And so the hero set out for battle, his faithful little servants with him.

file.name: Heroes\Fluffy\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionA.txt
file.text: \tEnemies are often deceived by Mimi’s appearance. It's a fatal error! This wonderful little animal is skilled at supporting his allies, parrying enemy attacks, stunning his enemies, and reducing their Stamina.\r\n\tBut that’s not all. Once he has accumulated enough Rage, Mimi unleashes his second nature, becoming a terrible beast that strikes panic into all his enemies and overwhelms them with a ferocious attack!

file.name: Heroes\Firefox\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyA.txt
file.text:
They live as one, a living fire and a sharp-eyed woman merged together into Fire Fox. As a child, her parents would comfort her by placing her cradle near her father's melting furnace. The girl would soon fall asleep, and with her, the flame would sink into slumber as the bellows ceased and the fire died down, diminishing into a pile of spark-shooting ashes.
The fire never harmed the girl, and even the most terrible explosive mixtures became mere fireworks in her hands. It is said that she once rescued a whole weapons manufactory from a terrible explosion. Molten metal from an overturned mold poured towards the explosive-laden warehouse, and only this fragile girl could stop the river of molten heat. Shortly after this incident, she visited the Imperial recruiters to accept the Prime, and joked that she had come to “finally legalize her relationship with flame.”
Even as a hero, Fire Fox never took anything seriously. She liked to flirt, her hood concealing a cheerful face with a playful smile. Suitors flocked to the girl, but Fire Fox was only once ever struck by Cupid's arrow. The dark yet graceful Prince of Thieves, an unwilling servant of the Imperium, stole her love once and for all. The fiery beauty boldly hurried to conquer the heart of this hero of the Keepers, but was rejected. Alas, the hand and heart of the prisoner belonged to another.
There is nothing worse than a woman scorned, especially one so used to being the center of attention. Fire Fox vowed revenge on the one who had dared to ignore her love. There is but a thin line between tenderness and hatred, and Fire Fox's passionate emotions burned hotter than the flames she controlled.

file.name: Heroes\Firefox\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyB.txt
file.text:
From her childhood, Flame Tail has been shrouded in legend. They say that, three days after her birth, a devastating fire engulfed her home. The heat and suffocating smoke prevented anyone from getting to the baby to help her. Suddenly, a nimble werefox with a Flame Tail jumped from the flames, holding a cradle in her teeth, with the girl inside, unharmed and smiling. The girl was named after her unexpected savior.
Restless and impetuous, like a real fox, Flame Tail was not born for a quiet life. Of all the arts, she chose the dangerous art of fire dancing. People came from all over the kingdom to watch her frenzied dance through rings of fire. Stunned, they witnessed as she would disappear into firestorms and then emerge, unharmed and beautiful. But one day, something went wrong, and when they put the fires out, they found only a flame-shaped brooch.
The girl did not want to play with fire any longer. Heeding the call of the Prime, she decided to become fire herself. The flaming brooch was her Catalyst, and the lord was able to revive her. But the newly reborn girl has changed dramatically. She now loves to incinerate things. She enjoys watching them burn, and the war has helped her channel her passion.
On the battlefield, Flame Tail gracefully dances among the enemy ranks, leaving a trail of smoking embers and ashes behind her.

file.name: Heroes\Firefox\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionA.txt
file.text: \tDespite her weak defense, Fire Fox is a formidable opponent. Her fiery talents ignite her enemies as she sends out streams of flame that engulf whole squads of enemy soldiers. Sly and cunning, just like a real fox, the hero can easily escape those who attempt to pursue her, becoming invisible when threatened.\r\n\tAlthough her combat style usually keeps her at a distance, raining bursts of fire down on her enemies, the hero is able to, for a short time, transform into a practically invincible demon of fire, destroying all enemies in the vicinity.

file.name: Heroes\FallenAngel\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionA.txt
file.text: \tThe gracious and powerful Raven has appeared to destroy all living things. She moves around the map on fiery wings, giving her enemies no chance to flee from her blue flame. Enemies attacked by Raven receive a fiery curse and bring chaos to their camp.

file.name: Heroes\FallenAngel\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionB.txt

file.name: Heroes\Fairy\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyA.txt
file.text:
The harmonious flight of the fairies delighted the girl. These small mindless creatures were the result of the Prime's influence on butterflies and dragonflies and loved the feeling of flying through the air. The girl dreamed of flying with them, guiding them, leader of the nimble fliers.
The girl's father was an unrecognized genius: all of his inventions had been out of place and time. He decided to make her daughter's fantasies a reality. The townsfolk and his colleagues laughed at him, but he stubbornly kept up his work. And that's how he died, in the prime of his life: misunderstood, ridiculed, and unneeded.
Analyzing the things in her father's library after his funeral, the girl found drawings of a flying apparatus, powered by a Prime engine. A resolution of the mechanics' workshops had judged the design: it would not fly. But despite all of that, the inventor's daughter decided to complete her father's work and prove his genius. When the helicopter unit was ready, the girl went up to the top of the belfry, put it on, fastened the belts, spun the blades, and, ignoring the cries of surprise and horror from below, stepped out into the void.
The joy of the flight, the fulfilment of the dreams which had captivated her for years, turned her into a hero. The awkward somersaults were soon replaced by confident and smooth turns. Suddenly, the air around her filled with fairies, and they adopted her as their leader, mimicking her every move. The girl realized that her childhood dream had come true.
Later, a special commission concluded that the flying apparatus was able to lift a modest weight into the air; however, only a hero could reliably control it. Naturally, these developments did not go unnoticed by the Imperium's armed forces. As soon as the war started, miniature girl-heroes with flying apparatuses bravely went off to the front.

file.name: Heroes\Fairy\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyB.txt
file.text:
Driven by the king's ransom offered them, Dokht smugglers kidnapped the Adornian lady's young pupil and hid with her in the Primezone. The best trackers returned empty-handed. The villains had vanished in the mists of the dangerous lands along the border.
Losing their way, the smugglers were themselves lost. The party wandered into the dwelling place of the winged Touched, named so by fairies in memory of the long-gone era of fairy tales. Though they were usually kind to all living creatures, the winged creatures suddenly went into a frenzy. Perhaps the fairies saw something unusual in the girl's heart, something familiar. They ambushed the smugglers and chased them out of their territory, forcing them to release their helpless prisoner.
Realizing that she could never find her way home, the girl stayed with the fairies. The place where they lived was not troubled by Touched predators and was filled with plenty of sweet flower nectar, which the girl soon learned to love. Soon the girl realized that the silly fairies were unwittingly fulfilling the unspoken desires she had had since she was a child. The girl began to feel herself change: wings grew on her back, and she started to experience the strange powers of her flying friends.
One day, the girl heard the noise of a battle nearby. On the road to Fairy Valley, an Adornian party struggled with a huge Touched fungus creature. Suddenly, a familiar coat of arms appeared from the trees. The lady's heroes had found the girl! The young girl called the fairies to her aid and joined the battle. She hung a spectral silhouette over the heroes' heads, and the fairies surrounded them, creating a protective cocoon of “winged flowers.” Others flew at the monster, preventing him from crushing the heroes.
The heroes triumphed, but only thanks to the help of the girl and her fairies. After the festivities in her honor had concluded, the lasy listened attentively to the girl's story. Soon, the Adornian lords learned how to create similar heros, with the help of nectar from Prime flowers.

file.name: Heroes\Fairy\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionA.txt
file.text: \tFay is a great support hero. By sending her fairies into the battle, she can attack enemies and protect allies. She can bring the wrath of her miniature helpers to bear at the crucial moment in the fight, causing significant damage to all nearby enemies.\r\n\tHer unique ability to unite with other heroes allows her to become invincible for a time. By doing this, Fay cannot only avoid danger but also increase an allied hero's combat abilities or hinder an enemy's.

file.text: \tThe Fairy Queen is a great support hero. By sending her fairies into the battle, she can attack enemies and protect allies. By doing this, the Fairy Queen cannot only avoid danger but also increase an allied hero's combat abilities or hinder an enemy's.

file.name: Heroes\Faceless\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyA.txt
file.text:
Once considered the greatest surgeon in the Imperium, he successfully treated thousands of mortally wounded and terminally ill patients. But when his operations were finished, the physician would not rest. He had a dream: to find a way to make human skin invulnerable so that no one would ever again have to suffer from trauma or injury.
When his preparations were completed, the doctor decided to conduct his first experiment. An experiment on himself. At first, everything went according to plan: he injected a specially designed Prime fragment into his skin... and then, severe pain assaulted the experimenter. The agony was intense, but the surgeon persevered, his goal driving him to press on, until he lost consciousness. When the experimenter awoke, it looked like his body was decomposing. He tried to find an antidote, but his attempts were in vain. There were no other surgeons like him, so he turned to the help of the Keepers' mages. Perhaps one of their spells had gone wrong? But, after enduring another ocean of pain, he discovered that his flesh was becoming ephemeral.
Filled with despair, he was sure that the Keepers had refused to help him out of envy for his great abilities. He lost his hope of regaining his old appearance and now yearned for only one thing: to find and destroy all those who laughed at lost dreams.
A mask hid his face, and his clothing covered his increasingly dissolving body. He became Faceless, creeping in the shadows, a cruel and skillful assassin. It was a simple matter, after all, to switch from a saving scalpel to a lethal knife. Revenge is now burning his soul out from within as his victims' suffering fills him with a perverse pleasure. Faceless even mocks his victims sometimes, feigning regret for their deaths.

file.name: Heroes\Faceless\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyB.txt
file.text:
In the ancient castle of the Keepers hung a long series of portraits. All had some mystery to them, but one was particularly striking: a white mask, gazing with empty eyes. Tradition says that sometimes, the image steps out of the canvas and wanders the region, and no one who encounters him lives to tell the tale...
Once, the castle passed into the hands of a fearless, enlightened lady. “We cannot live in such foolish terror,” she said. “I must destroy the portrait so that these silly fears are forgotten.” The servants would not dare argue with the lady, but none of them could bring themselves to touch the canvas. So the lady herself took the painting off the wall and thrust it into the fire...
A terrible sense of foreboding came upon all present. That night, everyone in the castle was awake, kept from sleep by a terrible anticipation. Hiding in silence and darkness, all prepared for a horrible end to the story. At midnight, the shadow of the white mask quietly crept through the corridors, and in the lady's room whispered frightening words: “I faithfully served the former owners of this castle, and I could have served you. But now, you will sleep forever...”
Even though Phantom has never since been seen in that region, the castle is deserted, of course. No one has the courage to become its new owner.

file.name: Heroes\Faceless\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionA.txt
file.text: \tFaceless specializes in surprise attacks and deathblows. His combos and defense are weak, but he makes up for these shortcomings with his quick movements and ever-increasing chances of scoring a critical hit. His talents are designed to slow and weaken his victim (by revealing his true face), making Faceless the ideal assassin.

file.name: Heroes\Ent\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyA.txt
file.text:
Crazy creatures sporting human torsos and snake’s tails first appeared in the Prime Zone after the Cataclysm. Dokht scientists believe that it was the Cataclysm that gave birth to this four-armed creatures, but some older people remember being frightened by legends of the terrible Naga when they were children.
One day, a disquieting Call drove a young naga to leave his native land. He soon found himself among tailless creatures, masters of metal, stone, and Prime. There he witnessed people with such incredible combat abilities that he was filled with a burning desire to cross his four swords with them.
He slithered out into a gladiator arena, where restless warriors yearning for battles and campaigns of old gave up their lives in vicious duels to the cheers of spectators. There, he challenged all the heroes present to battle. Those in attendance were shocked by this warrior’s brash fearlessness, and some even considered his challenge a joke. But the serpentman was so furiously insistent that four enraged Dokht heroes stepped forth onto the sand, filled with the Prime of the fights of the day.
Legends are still sung of that battle. Indeed, the Naga lost, but he survived, and even dealt all of his opponents very serious wounds. The lords seated among the spectators fought to recruit the hero onto their sides, but the Naga remained in the arena. Nothing interested him but cold combat and clear victory.
Over the years, the snakeman earned himself glory aplenty. His four-armed appearance ceased to be strange to the Dokhts, and more and more Nagas began to appear in the cities in the Imperium. Heroes were born among them at a surprising frequency.
When the war began, all of the warrior Nagas received orders to report to the front. None of them refused. The four-armed warriors handed their carefully-guarded catalysts, bone coming-of-age amulets, over to their lords and charged into the fray.

file.name: Heroes\Ent\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyB.txt
file.text:
It is said that there is no greater master of fencing in all of Praia then the four-armed sword magicians from the Naga tribles. But these warriors’ victories are not thanks to their physical build and talents alone. Perseverence is their greatest virtue, and before this strength even the most powerful opponents fall.
In his younger years, this future hero saw a fierce Naga fight a whole pack of wolves. One of the Dokht wolf dancers was looking to destroy the snake but failed utterly. The youth was impressed by the Naga’s fantastic swordsmanship, and he resolved then and there to follow the way of the blade to the last. He trained endlessly, and by the time twenty years had passed, he had become a skillful warrior. Wishing to prove his skills, the young warrior went to a Naga village and challenged their best swordsman to battle.
He lost. The serpentmen solemnly buried the dissected body of the brave fighter – but then, the persistent man returned as a hero. As he gave his catalyst to his lord, he agreed to unusual conditions of service, and once again went to the Naga and crossed swords with their champion. Once more, he fell, and as he rose again, he swore he would never cease trying until victory was his.
The lord, who time and time again was forced to ressurrect the fallen hero, happened to tell his story at a noble party. Lady Inessa – then lady of the Palace of Peace and considered the greatest master of ressurrection in the whole kingdom – was deeply impressed by the swordsman’s persistence. She wrote her fellow lord a special Song of Revival. When he was risen the next time, the hero had become a Naga, and thus he finally achieved his long-awaited victory.
This technique of turning human heroes into Naga later became available to other experienced lords, and many well-known swordsman decided to change their external forms into serpents so that they could wield four blades against the Dokhts in the growing war.

file.name: Heroes\Ent\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionA.txt
file.text: \tThe mighty Dendromonster is indispensable in the team – the power of wood raises the morale of his allies. As soon as his enemies get tangled up in dense thorns, the hero speeds up and catches up to his target with a whistle of the wind, dealing with it in a second.\r\n\tDon’t even think about angering the Dendromonster – the best of the best will be defeated when he unleashes his mighty shock.

file.name: Heroes\Dryad\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionA.txt
file.text: \tNature speaks through the mouth of the Dryad. In battle, the heroine uses the power of the forest to blind enemies and infect them with spores, making them more vulnerable to her attacks. A summoned spirit helps her detect hidden enemies and gain a tactical advantage. When caught unawares, the heroine turns into a tree and becomes invulnerable to enemy attacks, while in the heat of battle nature itself turns against the Dryad’s enemies, immobilizing them, growing spores and dealing damage to all nearby.

Da'Ka's accumulated Faith can slow down or blind enemies damaged by his talents.

file.name: Heroes\Chronicle\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionA.txt
file.text: \tTime is always on the Chronicle's side, and it is ruthless to her enemies. The heroine herself travels back to the past, in order to correct her mistakes; she also sends her enemies back in time, cutting off their route of escape. The Curse of Time draws up with an enemy, dazed by Chronicle and her allies' attacks. And even if it stuns the Heroine, Aegis of Time helps her to take the hit.\r\n\tDuring the Prime-time, Chronicle is the only one who is not affected by slowing of time. Her decisions at this moment often affect the final outcome of the battle.

file.text: \tNoone can stay indifferent to Kvasir's Spiced Mead: it increases allies' maximum Health and weakens his enemies. The hero easily moves all over the battlefield, spilling hot mead. This drink slows Kvasir's enemies down and deals periodic damage to them. If the hero's foes are not careful enough, the mead will make them so shaky that they won't be able to hold their weapons in their hands.

file.name: Heroes\BladeDancer\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyA.txt
file.text:
A slightly bruised lace jabot, a sarcastic grin, an unkind daring in blue eyes and the polished barrel of a gunblade: you won’t confuse him for anyone else. And the Duelist won’t let you – he only seems like a cold-blooded gentleman, but within him burns the desire for battle and the wish to find a worthy opponent. His fiery character played a poor joke on him in his youth, when a foolish argument caused the proud young man to challenge the emperor’s cousin to a duel. The death of his opponent sent the Duelist into exile; those that knew him then say that was probably best for everyone – since childhood, the fugitive had always loved adventure.
Since then, he has won many duels, gained fame as an excellent swordsman and marksman, and has traveled the length and breadth of nearly half the continent. Fortune favored him: the lucky devil has been in hundreds of battles and managed to survive in places from which few returned.
His aura of invincibility and refined manners are attractive to women: they are drawn to the hero like moths to bright light. He gladly spends a few nights with them and leaves – the swashbuckler’s heart was made for dangerous adventure, not for love.
The reckless daredevil loves to drive his enemies and allies alike crazy – sometimes the world seems so boring to him… Only he could leave as a catalyst the bullet that killed him for the very first time. And only he, wishing to make his heart race, sometimes steals it from the vault of a lord, to load it into his gunblade and duel against his own final death in his firing chamber.

file.name: Heroes\BladeDancer\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyB.txt
file.text:
Sentimental folk still believe that the Prince began to steal in his childhood, simply to survive. That is not true: he grew up in a rich society and never wanted for anything. His passion for particularly well protected things came slowly; he simply liked to obtain things that other people couldn’t have. And often, instead of fulfilling expensive orders, the Prince set off for lands of wonder for a rare trinket that was worth pennies, but was very extremely difficult to get.
The thief’s mastery grew with the years, he learned to steal into sacred temples, masking himself behind a smokescreen, but could also break his way through to his target through a crowd of guards – the Prince perfected the art of swordsmanship.
It was the fame of this brave and lucky thief that brought him to the attention of his enemies.
The dokht’s once captured the Prince’s lover. The situation he found himself in was worse than imprisonment. For four endless years, he worked for the dokhts and did much that is still terrible to recall.
The Prince managed to arrange the girl’s escape, and they obtained their long-awaited freedom. But when the hero returned to his homeland, many found him dark and silent. And since then, he has taken to his business only when he wanted to get something from the dokhts. When rumors emerged of a new war with the Empire, the hero was the first at the recruiting station.
The lord that he is sworn to serve can be calm: the Prince never disobeys an order. But don’t ask him about his past – he won’t speak of it. Or he will utter one of his mysterious phrases that awaken curiosity, but explain nothing.

file.name: Heroes\BladeDancer\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionA.txt
file.text: \tNone have yet escaped from Hellblade’s deadly blades. By changing his battle stance, he quickly switches from a swift assault to a reinforced defense, increasing his movement speed and chance of dodging attacks. The hero’s stances become truly powerful when Hellblade lets out his demonic power.

file.name: Heroes\BladeDancer\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionB.txt

file.name: Heroes\Bard\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyA.txt
file.text:
The pragmatic Dokhts dislike music; they relate better to hammers chiming on the anvil and the deep bellow of the smithy furs. Even if a talented performer was born in the Imperium, he could not hope for glory: for whom would he perform?
A gifted violinist, the Bard learned a lot on her own, echoing the melodies of wind, steam, and iron. But finding no acceptance at home, the maiden left for Adornia. There, she realized how imperfect her performance was, and began taking lessons from local masters. One of her mentors—a hero who had chosen the path of the Rat Master—had lured the girl not only with his fantastic music, but with his darkly handsome appearance, as well.
It is said that over time, after perfecting her skills, the girl eclipsed the best violinists of the kingdom, and even the hero-piper was disgruntled by the fame that the Dokht had earned in his homeland. Finally, Queen Isabel herself heard word of her remarkable gift and fancied relishing the performance of this guest from the North.
At the concert, the girl played the leading part, while the Rat Master accompanied her on his flute. Yet something strange happened with the violinist: her hands wouldn't obey her; she played flat and out of tune and broke a string. The audience booed and the queen left the hall before the concert was even over. Then, in front of a thousand spectators, the girl struck her former admirer with a slap in the face, for she had realized that it was his ability to cast spells that had disrupted her performance.
The offended violinist left Adornia, and for a while, all trace of her was lost. When she had finally reappeared in the Dokht Imperium, it was, to the surprise of many, as a hero. She hadn't forgotten what she had learned in Adornia, and she established the first conservatory in the Imperium, which, besides regular musicians, would also train Bard-heroes. The hero yearns to take on the Adornians in battle and find out whose strings are stronger and whose hands are more skilled.

file.name: Heroes\Bard\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyB.txt
file.text:
Typically, Muse heroes are committed to a life of creativity from their birth, but this girl's story was quite different. When she was still a girl, she ended up under the care of an influential lady, and everyone predicted that she would suppress his great patroness.
But her true potential was only discovered at the Academy of Lords, during classes on the resurrection of heroes. Her excellent musical ear and talents with the violin let the girl revive characters along with the lords, even though other subjects (economics, management, politics) came to her only with great difficulty.
More than anything else, the girl feared that she would disappoint her patroness, but the lady was socially experienced and knew that the Academy would be a prison for someone with such wonderful talent. She recommended that the girl train with one of her acquaintances, the Muse.
The girl was not a hero, but her path captivated her. Her art with her bow was her dream come true, and the sounds she made with her strings echoed her very soul. The thrill and excitement of free creativity encircled the girl in a sparkling carousel of delight, and she suddenly discovered her heroic talents. She was the first to discover her talents out of pure joy!
The lady blessed the young Muse and gave her a farewell gift: an elaborately carved cameo with a fragile dancing figure. But the hero refused to wear such a touching gift and instead turned it into a part of herself, making it her Catalyst.
The Muse had fulfilled her destiny. Now her fiddle would share her deepest feelings without interruption. When the war came to Adornia, the girl went to war to help the other heroes. Where the enemy strikes at those defending their home land, the Muse's music can strengthen her allies and wound her enemies.

file.name: Heroes\Bard\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionA.txt
file.text: \tThe Bard draws her strength from Inspiration, which selects the best melody for the current situation. Her music suppresses the enemy and prevents them from using their talents. Playing on her violin, the hero can strengthen her allies and protect them from the enemy's attacks.\r\n\tThe Bard does not rush to the center of the battle, but he can play a marvelous finale to make a difference in any battle.

file.name: Heroes\Bard\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionB.txt
file.text: \tThe Muse draws her strength from Inspiration, which selects the best melody for the current situation. Her music suppresses the enemy and prevents them from using their talents. Playing on her violin, the hero can strengthen her allies and protect them from the enemy's attacks.\r\n\tThe Muse does not rush to the center of the battle, but he can play a marvelous finale to make a difference in any battle.

file.name: Heroes\Banshee\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionA.txt
file.text: \tBanshee is known as a herald of impending death. When caught in the veil of shadows, her enemy quickly turns into the time-worn matter, doomed to perish from the heroine's horrifying shriek. The ability to disembody allows her to ignore obstacles and disappear from the view of those brave enough to chase her.\r\n\tBut if Banshee's enemies manage to overtake her, she will absorb their life force with a twilight burst, leaving nothing but empty shells behind.

file.name: Heroes\Assassin\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyA.txt
file.text:
Each contract must be completed, no matter who the target is or why they must be killed. The creed of the Eraser? “Ask no questions, work quickly and cleanly, and leave no witnesses.” The Organization makes the decisions, and no one dares to question them.
This target caused him no emotional response. He did not know what his target had done to deserve his fate. Perhaps he had contacted the Keepers and sold them some Imperium technology. In any case, if the Organization selected a target, that meant their patience was up, and it was time for the target to pay for his crimes.
But someone betrayed the Eraser and warned the target of the impending attack. The executioner dropped right into a squad of bodyguards. He was outmatched and suffered severe wounds, but he managed to skewer his enemy, fulfilling his mission, before he himself fell.
The hero was brought back to life in the Organization's secret citadel. The master of poisons, who had long aspired to leadership in the Organization, told the Eraser that the High Executioner had been bribed and had tried to save the target from his punishment. The Eraser now understood that the time for justice had come. The illusion of infallibility vanished, and the hero realized that even the most incorruptible of souls can fall. He tracked the leader down and masterfully applied his art.
From that time forth, the master of death decided that he would work to punish traitors and enemies of the Imperium, serving only a lord whom he trusted completely. A difficult task, for few trustworthy lords remained.

file.name: Heroes\Assassin\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyB.txt
file.text:
The impregnable abode in the Dawn Mountains has long been the hatching place of many infamous plans. It is rumored to be owned by a powerful clan of assassins, a group accepting only the most impossible missions. The leader will always complete a job, even at the expense of his men.
The Assassin has been a member of the clan since childhood, and when the time came for him to learn to kill, he did not hesitate, not even for a second. He trained hard, passed the first test with flying colors, and his list of hits was soon growing daily.
Finally, it was time for his last job, after which students become full-fledged warriors of the clan. But when he learned his objective, the Assassin was shocked. He was to kill the teacher who had been devoted to his training for so many years.
By night, he made his way unnoticed to the trainer's quarters, woke him, and silently showed him the scroll with his name. “You do not understand, my boy,” the teacher answered quietly. “Today is your final examination. Today, you prove that you have become stronger than me, your teacher. That you have become the best of the best. It is I who wrote my name in the scroll. Defend yourself!”
The mentor snatched a weapon and lunged at the Assassin. The fight was long and hard, but in the end, youth overcome experience. His wounds bleeding, the student stood over the teacher's body and saw a golden medallion in his mentor's clenched fingers.
That night, the future hero left the fortress for good. The clan had nothing more to teach him. Only in war could he find worthy opponents. Only there could he improve his skills.
The Assassin did not try to heal the scars on his flesh. Instead, he covered them with tattoos, in memory of his slain mentor. His Catalyst, the gold medallion etched with the mark of a true killer, remains guarded in the lord's castle.

file.name: Heroes\Assassin\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionA.txt
file.text: \tWhen the Eraser kills enemies, his class talents cool down quickly, and he can use them to become invisible, easily elude his pursuers, and stealthily sneak up to the enemy once again.\r\n\tSelecting a victim, the Eraser places a special mark on him that allows him to finish him off swiftly. And if the target survives the initial attack, an insidious strike will prevent him from escaping the lightning attacks which seal his fate.

file.name: Heroes\Assassin\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionB.txt
file.text: \tWhen the Assassin kills enemies, his class talents cool down quickly, and he can use them to become invisible, easily elude his pursuers, and stealthily sneak up to the enemy once again.\r\n\tSelecting a victim, the Assassin places a special mark on him that allows him to finish him off swiftly. And if the target survives the initial attack, an insidious strike will prevent him from escaping the lightning attacks which seal his fate.

file.name: Heroes\Artist\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyB.txt
file.text:
With each passing year, she perfected her skills. People said that her paintings could heal people who touched them. But for every talent, there is someone who is jealous of it. Overcome with rage, the girl's enemies invited her to the Autumn Colors festival, in which the painters use pure Prime.
As soon as the tournament began, the girl discovered that her brushes had been stolen. But her opponents had already begun, so the young participant dipped her tender hands into the Prime! As she painted, she failed to notice the crimson drops of blood seeping from her fingers.
The judges wanted to stop the contest, but the girl was so absorbed with her art that she left the canvas and began to paint a picture of a snow-white bird. It flapped its wings and zoomed over the stands. The fascinated crowd watched with admiration, but the girl collapsed, exhausted as the Prime oozed into her bloodstream.
The direct contact with the Prime awakened the hero within her, but the girl just wanted to continue creating art, so the country's master painter took her on as an apprentice. However, the Artiste could no longer paint living pictures, so the Keeper gave her a Master's Brush, suggesting that the ancient tool might help. He was right. The girl was again able to paint living works.
Unfortunately, the Dokhts learned about the special brush and wanted to have it for themselves, so they sent the Eraser after it. He seized the brush and fatally wounded the master painter. To protect her teacher, the Artiste waved her hands, and the beast she painted rushed towards the Eraser.
“This brush is a simple piece of wood, but it helped you believe in yourself,” the hero's dying teacher whispered. “The talent lies in the creator, not the tool...” Thus the Artiste became a hero. But even when she is in the heat of a desperate battle, she longs to create art, instead.

file.name: Heroes\Artist\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionA.txt
file.text: \tThe Artiste, an elegant girl, skillfully wields her magic brush. Her magical paints penetrate any defense, and allies creating a magic scroll with them can keep a copy for themselves. Her paints heal her friends and deal damage to her enemies, slowing them down.\r\n\tAnimals painted by the Artiste come to life, knocking back her opponents. When she's in a tough spot, Master's Paintbrush increases her power, allowing her to paint more frequently and making her paintings larger.

file.name: Heroes\Artist\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionB.txt
file.text: \tThe Artiste, an elegant girl, skillfully wields her magic brush. Her magical paints penetrate any defense, and allies creating a magic scroll with them can keep a copy for themselves. Her paints heal her friends and deal damage to her enemies, slowing them down.\r\n\tAnimals painted by Artiste come to life, knocking back her opponents. When she's in a tough spot, Master's Paintbrush increases her power, allowing her to paint more frequently and making her paintings larger.

file.name: Heroes\Archeress\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyA.txt
file.text:
Without neglecting the worthiness of other heroes, it would be good to take some time to tell you about the hero popularly known as the Archer. Rumor has it that she was awarded this nickname as a child when she showed astounding skill with a large bow.
The strictness of the lord's family did not permit him to marry one of the Prime Inductor attendants, but he broke with tradition, and his lover and their newborn baby girl moved into the castle. Unfortunately, the girl's mother soon died, and the child was raised by her father. She grew quickly and realized the power of her beauty and artfulness early on. She accomplished many things in life, but her main hobby was archery. The high-tech device that the Archer uses so masterfully in battle was given to her by her father when she came of age. Unfortunately, that birthday really was the end of her childhood.
A treacherous neighbor attacked the lord's land. Perhaps the villain planned on quickly snatching some neighboring land, with the support of the other lords, to avoid the wrath of the Emperor.
But the fighting was long and hard. Although the girl's father was killed, the surviving troops and civilian refugees fled to the forest. The Archer and those under her command riddled the enemy soldiers with arrows, but the invaders were too many. The lordship was drowning in blood, and the girl decided on a desperate plan: she snuck into the captured castle to attempt to resurrect the fallen heroes. But the knowledge she had gleaned from her mother's books and from watching her father was not enough. The Prime Inductor exploded... turning the girl into a hero.
The Emperor himself revived her, when the Imperial Guard intervened to stop the neighboring lord's invasion and punish the traitors responsible. Now, the grateful Archer fights for the ideals of the Imperium.
Great Women of the Great Imperium, Volume 1, New Lafort, 72 P.E.

file.name: Heroes\Archeress\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroBiographyB.txt
file.text:
Sometimes, Cupid's arrow brings not love but death.
A superb archer, the Amazon quickly attracted the lord's attention and was selected to lead a detachment of elite soldiers. The lord valued the girl for her ability, but more so for her captivating beauty. He often helped the girl with favors, but she was hesitant to answer in kind. The noble Amazon did not wish to offend another suitor: a young warrior, a childhood friend with whom she had studied archery.
The warrior did not think he could compete with the talented and wealthy lord, especially since the Amazon always said that the warrior and she were only friends, though close friends. The poison of jealousy infected his soul, and the last straw was another gift that the lord gave the girl.
A company of troops was pursuing some Imperium spies that had infiltrated the kingdom. In the ensuing firefight, the young warrior was covering the Amazon, who was looking for a good place in the trees to position herself. Jealousy took hold of him. He drew his bow, pointed it at her back, and whispered: “Now no one can have you.” Perhaps from some sort of intuition, the girl turned around at the last moment. As he released the arrow, the warrior's eyes met the girl's knowing gaze. Only then did he realize what he had done...
The warrior took the girl's body to his lord and begged him to revive her. An amulet, damaged by the arrow, was found around her neck, a gift her future killer had given her as a child, a gift she had kept near her heart. The shards of the amulet became Amazon's first Catalyst. The hero was revived, but she no longer wished to have anything to do with any of these hapless suitors.

file.name: Heroes\Archeress\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionA.txt
file.text: \tArcher's arrows are deadly, dealing physical and magical damage simultaneously. She finds the largest and most well-armored enemies' weak spots and takes advantage of them.\r\n\tThe fragile-looking Archer is actually a formidable opponent: suddenly changing her vantage point, she unleashes a barrage of arrows at the enemy then finishes off weakened enemies with a decisive shot.

file.name: Heroes\Angel\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionA.txt
file.text: \tMediatrix is always ready to come to the aid of her allies. She is the only hero who cannot be stopped by any distance, or even by her own death! Her very presence restores Energy to her allies, her Angelic Light heal them, and her Spirit Beacon makes them stronger in battle.\r\n\tHer foes should try to avoid being caught in the path of her Angelic Light, which will slow them down, and steer clear of her Spear of Vengeance, which Mediatrix is eager to send anywhere on the map where her allies might need help.

file.name: Heroes\Alchemist\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionA.txt
file.text: \tBy damaging her enemies with noxious substances and slowing them down with portions of glue, Doctrine uses enemy heroes to distil ingredients and components of Prime from their bodies as required for clone creation according to descriptive alchemy.\r\n\tIf the Alchemical Circle is drawn correctly, she will end up in the right place at the right time to unleash the relentless power of alchemy at her foes.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D04_phrasesA_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: Just in the nick of time, Ash. I owe you one!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D04_phrasesA_1_textFemale.txt
file.text: What a catastrophe! Not fair! I was going to win!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D04_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: I'll be damned! Just when I was about to finish her off...

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D04_phrasesB_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: Thanks, Spark! I wouldn't have made it without you!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D04_phrasesB_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Thanks, Gale! Just a little more, and... ugh, I don't even want to think about it!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D04_phrasesB_1_textFemale.txt
file.text: I don't believe it! One more blow and it would have been over...

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D04_phrasesB_1_textMale.txt
file.text: I don't believe it! One more blow and it would have been over...
