file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D05_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: You can only destroy internal constructions once you've already destroyed the external constructions that stand in your line of sight. Therefore, you won't be able to destroy the second tower from the center along a given line if you haven't already destroyed the first one.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D05_phrasesB_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: Just tell me, just how sane is he, anyway? A toad he may well be, but still he has to realize that you can't destroy the base while the towers are still standing. The towers are where you begin, and here he comes running, quick as a flash. Went out like a flash, too.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D05_phrasesB_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Even the Dokht heroes are weird. What could this toad have possibly done to our base? The external walls are still intact, not to mention the internal ones, and the thing just keeps coming. That's why he melted in an instant, like a snowflake in a mountain stream.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D05_phrasesB_1_textMale.txt
file.text: You can only destroy internal constructions once you've already destroyed the external constructions that stand in your line of sight. Therefore, you won't be able to destroy the second tower from the center along a given line if you haven't already destroyed the first one.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D06_phrasesA_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: What a catastrophe! Not fair! I was going to win!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D06_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: I'll be damned! Just when I was about to finish her off...

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D06_phrasesA_1_textFemale.txt
file.text: Just in the nick of time, Ash. I owe you one!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D06_phrasesA_2_textFemale.txt
file.text: We should heal our wounds. Luckily, we can do that at the Prime Inductor whenever we need.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D06_phrasesA_2_textMale.txt
file.text: I've got to heal my wounds—that stupid frog gave me a bloody nose. It's a good thing the Prime Inductor's right here.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D06_phrasesA_3_textFemale.txt
file.text: But if you get too far from base, you can always heal up with a special potion. Let's stop by the shop and pick up a flask for each of us.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D06_phrasesA_3_textMale.txt
file.text: Ah, I almost forgot to buy potions, and here we are right next to the shop! You might want to get one yourself.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D06_phrasesB_0_textMale.txt
file.text: I don't believe it! One more blow and it would have been over...

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D06_phrasesB_1_textFemale.txt
file.text: Thanks, Spark! I wouldn't have made it without you!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D06_phrasesB_1_textMale.txt
file.text: Thanks, Gale! Just a little more, and... ugh, I don't even want to think about it!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D06_phrasesB_2_textFemale.txt
file.text: We should heal our wounds. Luckily, we can do that at the Prime Spring whenever we need.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D06_phrasesB_2_textMale.txt
file.text: I've got to heal my wounds—that stupid frog gave me a bloody nose. It's a good thing the Prime Spring is right here.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D06_phrasesB_3_textFemale.txt
file.text: But if you get too far from base, you can always heal up with a special potion. Let's stop by the shop and pick up a flask for each of us.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D06_phrasesB_3_textMale.txt
file.text: Let's stop by the shop and grab something for the road.—I got caught without a Healing Potion there and almost died!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D07_phrasesA_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: By the way, Ash, do you have any thoughts on Native Terrain tactics?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D07_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: By the way, you remember about taking advantage of Native Terrain, right?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D07_phrasesA_1_textFemale.txt
file.text: We can raise Imperial banners on Neutral lands, we'll strengthen our talents.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D07_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: Right. When we raise our flag on neutral territory, we make the area our own. And fighting on Native Terrain is a lot more effective!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D07_phrasesB_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: By the way, what do you make of Native Terrain and its tactical advantages?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D07_phrasesB_0_textMale.txt
file.text: By the way, you remember about Native Terrain, don't you?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D07_phrasesB_1_textFemale.txt
file.text: By raising the Adornian banner over neutral land, we change it into Native Terrain -- where our talents shine even brighter.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D07_phrasesB_1_textMale.txt
file.text: When we raise our flag on neutral territory, we transform the land into our own. And fighting on Native Terrain is a lot more effective!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D08_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: It takes time to raise a flag. If a hero is attacked, moves, or uses a talent while raising a flag, the action is interrupted and must be started again.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D08_phrasesB_0_textMale.txt
file.text: It takes time to raise a flag. If a hero is attacked, moves, or uses a talent while raising a flag, the action is interrupted and must be started again.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D09_phrasesA_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: Perfect! Those pines are so familiar! Even the stumps feel like home...

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D09_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Nice! Now everything we see around us is Dokht, the way it was meant to be!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D09_phrasesA_1_textFemale.txt
file.text: Let's get to the next flag, and extend the Empire's influence over the battlefield.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D09_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: Looks great! Should we raise the central flag as well?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D09_phrasesB_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: Our land is so much prettier than the neutral variety! Not to mention the alien Dokht territory!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D09_phrasesB_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Excellent! What a pleasure it is to take a deep breath of fresh air!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D09_phrasesB_1_textFemale.txt
file.text: It's time we raise the flag in the center of the battlefield.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D09_phrasesB_1_textMale.txt
file.text: It'll be even better once we raise the central flag!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D10_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: The Adornian Flame Thrower, which specializes in destroying buildings, can also raise flags.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D10_phrasesB_1_textMale.txt
file.text: The Dokht Destroyer, which specializes in destroying buildings, can also raise flags.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D11_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: It's great that you can at any moment return to the Prime Inductor (Prime Spring) and quickly heal all of your wounds!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D11_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: Explains that she almost became food for the fishes, since she forget to buy a Health Elixir. Going to correct this mistake. Advises the player to buy an elixir, too.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D11_phrasesB_0_textMale.txt
file.text: It's great that you can at any moment return to the Prime Inductor (Prime Spring) and quickly heal all of your wounds!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D11_phrasesB_1_textMale.txt
file.text: Explains that she almost became food for the fishes, since she forget to buy a Health Elixir. Going to correct this mistake. Advises the player to buy an elixir, too.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D13_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: Suggests the player attack, conquer the enemy's flag, and raise one of his own.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D13_phrasesB_1_textMale.txt
file.text: Suggests the player attack, conquer the enemy's flag, and raise one of his own.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D14_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Grrr… What do we have here? A clever little mosquito and his girlfriend!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D14_phrasesA_1_textFemale.txt
file.text: Don't rush into battle, Ash! That fellow is too powerful and frontal attack won't end well.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D14_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: Careful, that hero is stronger than both of us at the moment!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D14_phrasesA_2_textMale.txt
file.text: The enemy hero's level is displayed next to his Health and Energy.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D14_phrasesA_3_textFemale.txt
file.text: I agree, he looks pretty terrifying. But why don't we try luring him to our tower… we built it for a reason, after all...

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D14_phrasesA_3_textMale.txt
file.text: He won't be a problem. Let's lure that hairball towards our tower, and then hit him with everything we've got!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D14_phrasesB_1_textFemale.txt
file.text: Don't rush into battle, Spark. A frontal attack would accomplish nothing.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D14_phrasesB_1_textMale.txt
file.text: Careful, right now that enemy here is stronger than both of us!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D14_phrasesB_2_textMale.txt
file.text: The enemy hero's level is displayed next to his Health and Energy.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D14_phrasesB_3_textFemale.txt
file.text: We'll need to take him out carefully. Let's lure him over to our tower. We'll pretend we're retreating, and he'll chase us...

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D14_phrasesB_3_textMale.txt
file.text: We can't beat him by brute force—but we can use guile. Retreat to the tower! He'll pursue us and then we can hand him his pelt!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D15_phrasesA_1_textFemale.txt
file.text: What's the matter, don't like cats? Maybe you just don't know how to cook them!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D15_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: Ha ha, our little pet isn't so scary after all!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D15_phrasesA_2_textMale.txt
file.text: The higher the enemy hero's level, the more Prime you receive for defeating them.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D15_phrasesB_1_textFemale.txt
file.text: Who's afraid of the big bad wolf?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D15_phrasesB_1_textMale.txt
file.text: Who's afraid of the big bad wolf?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D15_phrasesB_2_textMale.txt
file.text: The higher the enemy hero's level, the more Prime you receive for defeating them.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D16_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Small fry galore! I don't want to waste any time on them.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D16_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: You receive more Prime for dealing a finishing blow to the enemy than for merely participating in the foe's destruction.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D16_phrasesA_2_textFemale.txt
file.text: There might not be all that much, but there's a little secret—most of the Prime goes to the hero who deals the killing blow.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D16_phrasesA_2_textMale.txt
file.text: Just remember that whoever finishes off the foe gets the most Prime.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D16_phrasesB_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: Hey, these aren't anywhere near our league.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D16_phrasesB_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Ho ho ho! Hordes of puny pests, a waste of fire.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D16_phrasesB_1_textMale.txt
file.text: You receive more Prime for dealing a finishing blow to the enemy than for merely participating in the foe's destruction.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D16_phrasesB_2_textFemale.txt
file.text: I have enough fire for everybody. Remember that whoever delivers the killing blow to the enemy gets the most Prime.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D16_phrasesB_2_textMale.txt
file.text: Just remember that whoever finishes off the foe gets the most Prime.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D17_phrasesA_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: I see our outpost is standing strong, so what was that fool doing here?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D17_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: I see our outpost is standing strong, so what was that fool doing here?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D17_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: The Adornians on the other bank of the river have wasted no time. They've nearly finished a keep of their own!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D17_phrasesA_2_textFemale.txt
file.text: Feel like having some fun, Ash? I think that Art Temple over there has worn out its welcome. Think we should take care of it?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D17_phrasesA_2_textMale.txt
file.text: Say Thunder, I don't suppose you'd feel like unleashing your fury on the Adornian Art Temple?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D17_phrasesA_3_textMale.txt
file.text: You can only destroy inner enemy structures after you've already destroyed their outer structures.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D17_phrasesB_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: I can never understand Imperium heroes. What could that bullfrog possibly hope to do to our base?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D17_phrasesB_0_textMale.txt
file.text: I can never understand Imperium heroes. What could that bullfrog possibly hope to do to our base?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D17_phrasesB_1_textMale.txt
file.text: The Dokhts on the other bank of the river have wasted no time. They've nearly finished a keep of their own!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D17_phrasesB_2_textFemale.txt
file.text: Well then, Spark, the enemy Science Lodge awaits! It won't stand a chance against us.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D17_phrasesB_2_textMale.txt
file.text: So, Gale, shall we teach those Dokhts to dance with fire and lightning?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D17_phrasesB_3_textMale.txt
file.text: You can only destroy inner enemy structures after you've already destroyed their outer structures.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D18_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Points out that they are both injured and suggests the elixirs not be wasted. Better to teleport to base and be healed there. You need to purchase a special talent to teleport. He adds that you can only teleport to a location on Native Terrain.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D18_phrasesB_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Points out that they are both injured and suggests the elixirs not be wasted. Better to teleport to base and be healed there. You need to purchase a special talent to teleport. He adds that you can only teleport to a location on Native Terrain.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D19_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Suggests returning and destroying the enemy tower.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D19_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: The trip won't be very long, but they need to talk about something.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D19_phrasesA_3_textMale.txt
file.text: Tries to get the last word.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D19_phrasesB_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Suggests returning and destroying the enemy tower.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D19_phrasesB_1_textMale.txt
file.text: The trip won't be very long, but they need to talk about something.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D19_phrasesB_3_textMale.txt
file.text: Tries to get the last word.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D20_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: The hero is dead. Don't be upset, he'll resurrect soon.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D22_phrasesA_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: And here's our Destroyer! He can destroy the enemy flag and raise our own.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D22_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: And here's our Destroyer! He can destroy the enemy flag and raise our own.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D22_phrasesA_1_textFemale.txt
file.text: Now there's a smart boy! And he looks a lot better than that red monkey of theirs!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D22_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: He's like that red Adornian monster, only he's one of ours.—In other words, he's a lot better!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D22_phrasesB_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: And here's our Flame Thrower! He can destroy the enemy flag and raise our own.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D22_phrasesB_0_textMale.txt
file.text: And here's our Flame Thrower! He can destroy the enemy flag and raise our own.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D22_phrasesB_1_textFemale.txt
file.text: Look at that Dokht monster! Living fire is better than dead iron any day!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D22_phrasesB_1_textMale.txt
file.text: Where's Dokht dying - to Adornian spirit! Great, the flag is alright, let's move!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D23_1_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: The Portal talent quickly transports a hero to any point on Native Terrain selected by the player.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D23_phrasesA_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: There's some weirdo in a hat over there! With bells on! Ouch, and rats… Ugh!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D23_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: A straw hat and lots of rats. An Adornian garbage-monger!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D23_phrasesA_1_textFemale.txt
file.text: Don't look at my hat! Keep your eyes on your feet! My little army is about to pay you a visit!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D23_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: What are you squealing about? Something about cleaning up? Never fear, my rats are just about to take you out with the rest of the filth!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D23_phrasesA_2_textFemale.txt
file.text: Be careful not to get too close to a tower, Ash! It will turn and attack you!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D23_phrasesA_2_textMale.txt
file.text: We better not try to take him on near the tower. It would wipe us out with a couple shots before we even knew what hit us!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D23_phrasesA_3_textFemale.txt
file.text: Oh, really? Relax. The tower will strike our foot soldiers first. We'll be careful not to get too close—just close enough to twist somebody's rat's tail!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D23_phrasesA_3_textMale.txt
file.text: Never fear. Towers always attacks foot soldiers first. It only switches to heroes when there's no one else around. Let's lure the foul creature away from his tower, and give him a fight to remember!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D23_phrasesA_5_textFemale.txt
file.text: What the… Get your dirty paws off me, you spawn of a rat!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D23_phrasesA_6_textMale.txt
file.text: Don't worry, the allied hero will resurrect soon.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D23_phrasesA_7_textFemale.txt
file.text: What the?! Well, come back soon—we've got unfinished business.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D23_phrasesA_7_textMale.txt
file.text: Ahh… Oh well, it happens sometimes… But come back quickly—we have unfinished business.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D23_phrasesB_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: What's this? A Dokht in a hat, wearing sunglasses? Is he really so cool, or is he just clowning around?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D23_phrasesB_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Sunglasses and a whistle… Hmm… I smell a rat!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D23_phrasesB_1_textFemale.txt
file.text: I can't stand the sight of you, decadent scum. A good Adornian is a dead Adornian!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D23_phrasesB_1_textMale.txt
file.text: I smell Adornian filth! Let me sing you a lullaby…

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D23_phrasesB_2_textFemale.txt
file.text: We better not attack him right next to their tower. It would just start firing on us!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D23_phrasesB_2_textMale.txt
file.text: But be careful! If we attack him right next to the tower, it'll start defending him.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D23_phrasesB_3_textFemale.txt
file.text: Right, but if we don't attack him, the tower will just fire at our soldiers. Meanwhile, we can lure him away from his tower...

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D23_phrasesB_3_textMale.txt
file.text: Right. Towers normally target foot soldiers first, but the second you lay a hand on an enemy hero… You know what—let's lure him out!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D23_phrasesB_5_textFemale.txt
file.text: Celestial storms! Don't you touch me, you...

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D23_phrasesB_6_textMale.txt
file.text: Don't worry, the allied hero will resurrect soon.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D23_phrasesB_7_textFemale.txt
file.text: What awful songs the ratcatcher plays. Thunder, I'm waiting!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D23_phrasesB_7_textMale.txt
file.text: Ah, that's a shame. Spark, get back here as soon as you can!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D24_phrasesA_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: Apparently, we also have a siege machine that removes enemy banners and raises our own in their place

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D24_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Apparently, we also have a siege machine that removes enemy banners and raises our own in their place

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D24_phrasesA_1_textFemale.txt
file.text: Is relieved to realize they have siege machines of their own

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D24_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: Is relieved to realize they have siege machines of their own

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D25_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Heroes always revive at their home base.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D26_1_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: You can tell if an enemy hero is alive or dead by looking at his portrait: it the portrait is dark, the hero is down. The time left until he is resurrected is displayed on the portrait.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D26_2_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Portraits of allied heroes appear next to the player's hero, and contain information about the ally's level, Health, and Energy.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D26_phrasesA_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: There's some weirdo in a hat over there! With bells on! He must think it's a very stylish outfit...

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D26_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Fur undershorts and a straw hat. And rats, lots of rats. Adornian garbage-monger!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D26_phrasesB_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: Oh, a Dokht in a hat, wearing sunglasses? Is he really so refined, or just horsing around?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D26_phrasesB_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Sunglasses and a whistle... Hmm... I smell a rat!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D29_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: I got a little sidetracked there...

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D31_phrasesA_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: You were incredible, Thunder! I swear, those lightning bolts of yours...

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D31_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: You fought very well, Ash! I'm impressed.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D31_phrasesA_1_textFemale.txt
file.text: We were both great, especially you, Ash!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D31_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: You were amazing, Thunder! We sure gave it to them, didn't we?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D31_phrasesB_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: You're the best partner I've ever hoped for! I just love the flash of lightning!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D31_phrasesB_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Perfect! The way you twirled in a fiery dance, I just couldn't look away!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D31_phrasesB_1_textFemale.txt
file.text: We can always count on your fiery temperament, Spark, but today you really outdid yourself!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D31_phrasesB_1_textMale.txt
file.text: Nice job to you, Gale! What could I have done without your lightning bolts?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D32_phrasesA_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: Watch out—there's two of them now!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D32_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Ouch, two of them now, and they're both so ugly... Ewwwww.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D32_phrasesA_3_textFemale.txt
file.text: Target the one that I'm attacking! It's better to take one of them out first!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D32_phrasesA_3_textMale.txt
file.text: Let's pick them off one by one, and not spread ourselves too thin. Concentrate fire on my target! Ready! Now!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D32_phrasesB_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: Two more Dokhts left in our wake.—And a little more Prime for us! What could be better?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D32_phrasesB_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Oh, the Dokht peasants are back! Ready for some fun, boys?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D32_phrasesB_1_textMale.txt
file.text: What!? Destroy our base, will you?!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D32_phrasesB_3_textFemale.txt
file.text: Gale, let's join forces, and focus on a single target!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D32_phrasesB_3_textMale.txt
file.text: Attack with me! Let's concentrate our attacks! We'll take them down much faster if we work together.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D33_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: Our position here is right on the Adornian border, so the fighting never stops.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D33_phrasesA_2_textMale.txt
file.text: We've just finished Fort Granite, which is to become a key part of our border defenses.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D33_phrasesB_1_textMale.txt
file.text: Our position here is right on the Dokht border, where the fighting never quiets.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D33_phrasesB_2_textMale.txt
file.text: We've just finished Point Scarlet, which is to become a key part of our border defenses.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D35_phrasesA_1_textFemale.txt
file.text: Let's keep hitting their base. Just don't get too close to their Prime Spring! What heals enemy heroes is death for us!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D35_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: All we need to do now is destroy the Art Temple. Just don't get too close to their Prime Spring, Ash. It's dangerous if you get in its range.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D35_phrasesB_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Things just aren't going my way today...

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D35_phrasesB_1_textFemale.txt
file.text: One thing left—we've got to destroy their Science Lodge. Just don't get too close to that Prime Inductor. What heals the enemy is death for us!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D35_phrasesB_1_textMale.txt
file.text: All we we need to do now is destroy their Science Lodge. Just be careful not to get too close to their Prime Inductor, Spark. If you get too close, it'll shoot you down.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D40_1_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: You have enough Prime to activate a talent.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D40_2_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Activate an available talent that has additional benefits when used on your Native Terrain.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D40_3_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Notice that the talent is currently available.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D40_4_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Now, click to close the talent window.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D40_5_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Press the Prime Reservoir button to open the talent window.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D41_1_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Keep in mind that talents from a higher row have more powerful effects than those from a lower row.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_D41_2_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: You have enough Prime to activate one more talent.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_H01_LMC_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: RIGHT-click on the shop to open the purchase window.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_H01_RMC_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: LEFT-click on the shop to open the purchase window.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_H02_LMC_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: To raise a flag, click on it with the RIGHT mouse button.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission2\TM2_H02_RMC_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: To raise a flag, click on it with the LEFT mouse button.

file.text: To cancel the Talent use while selecting the target, click RIGHT mouse button

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\HintAndBubbleList_M1.HINTS_hints_10_text.txt
file.text: This talent is not yet ready.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\HintAndBubbleList_M1.HINTS_hints_12_text.txt
file.text: You have enough Prime to activate a talent.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\HintAndBubbleList_M1.HINTS_hints_13_text.txt
file.text: Click to see all of the talents available to this hero.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\HintAndBubbleList_M1.HINTS_hints_14_text.txt
file.text: Activate one of the available talents now.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\HintAndBubbleList_M1.HINTS_hints_15_text.txt
file.text: Activating a talent increases the hero's LEVEL and makes him or her more powerful.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\HintAndBubbleList_M1.HINTS_hints_16_text.txt
file.text: Every 4 levels, the hero unlocks a new stage of talents. The higher the stage, the more powerful the talents it holds.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\HintAndBubbleList_M1.HINTS_hints_17_text.txt
file.text: ACTIVE talents let you use heroic abilities.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\HintAndBubbleList_M1.HINTS_hints_18_text.txt
file.text: PASSIVE talents have a persistent bonus effect on the hero.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\HintAndBubbleList_M1.HINTS_hints_19_text.txt
file.text: Select any of the available talents.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\HintAndBubbleList_M1.HINTS_hints_1_text.txt
