file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\HintAndBubbleList_M1.HINTS_hints_20_text.txt
file.text: Press the Prime Reservoir button to open the talent window.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\HintAndBubbleList_M1.HINTS_hints_21_text.txt
file.text: The Talent window can now be closed.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\HintAndBubbleList_M1.HINTS_hints_22_text.txt
file.text: Now, click to close the talent window.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\HintAndBubbleList_M1.HINTS_hints_23_text.txt
file.text: An enemy hero is a dangerous opponent, especially when using talents.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\HintAndBubbleList_M1.HINTS_hints_24_text.txt
file.text: Your Health is low! Use a healing potion.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\HintAndBubbleList_M1.HINTS_hints_25_text.txt
file.text:
You may reassign a mouse button for movements and attack
in the Settings (press Esc).

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\HintAndBubbleList_M1.HINTS_hints_26_text.txt
file.text: The button next to the mini-map centers the main screen on your hero.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\HintAndBubbleList_M1.HINTS_hints_27_text.txt
file.text: You can cancel a talent when selecting a target by pressing the RIGHT mouse button.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\HintAndBubbleList_M1.HINTS_hints_2_text.txt
file.text: Click on an enemy with the LEFT mouse button to attack.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\HintAndBubbleList_M1.HINTS_hints_3_text.txt
file.text: Click on an enemy with the RIGHT mouse button to attack.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\HintAndBubbleList_M1.HINTS_hints_4_text.txt
file.text: This number represents the amount of Prime available.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\HintAndBubbleList_M1.HINTS_hints_5_text.txt
file.text: Click to use Prime to activate this talent.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\HintAndBubbleList_M1.HINTS_hints_6_text.txt
file.text: This talent is now available for use. You'll need it soon.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\HintAndBubbleList_M1.HINTS_hints_7_text.txt
file.text: Press Space to get back to your hero.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\HintAndBubbleList_M1.HINTS_hints_8_text.txt
file.text: Press “1” or click on the talent with the LEFT mouse button to use it.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\HintAndBubbleList_M1.HINTS_hints_9_text.txt
file.text: Then select a target for the talent with the LEFT mouse button.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D01_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: The Flint outpost, under the command of the legendary hero Moguta, is just ahead.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D01_phrasesA_2_textFemale.txt
file.text: The hero Ash has received your orders to visit the fortress and meet with Moguta, who has some troubling news to share...

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D01_phrasesA_2_textMale.txt
file.text: The hero Thunder has received your orders to visit the fortress and meet with Moguta, who has some troubling news to share...

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D01_phrasesA_3_textFemale.txt
file.text: Who's that over there? I'll ask him where Moguta is.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D01_phrasesA_3_textMale.txt
file.text: So... where is Moguta? Perhaps that green man over there knows…

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D01_phrasesB_1_textMale.txt
file.text: The Steel Flower fortress, under the command of the legendary hero Takeshi, is just ahead.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D01_phrasesB_2_textFemale.txt
file.text: The hero Spark has received your orders to visit the fortress and meet with Takeshi, who has some troubling news to share...

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D01_phrasesB_2_textMale.txt
file.text: The hero Gale has received your orders to visit the fortress and meet with Takeshi, who has some troubling news to share...

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D01_phrasesB_3_textFemale.txt
file.text: Who's that strange person over there? Hmm, maybe he knows where Takeshi is.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D01_phrasesB_3_textMale.txt
file.text: Well, where's Takeshi? Maybe that odd fellow knows…

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D02_LMC_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Click the LEFT mouse button on the point you wish to move to.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D02_RMC_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Click the RIGHT mouse button on the point you wish to move to.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D03_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Help! It looks like someone is hiding out there beyond the gates! Sound the alarm!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D03_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: Shaded areas of the map indicate areas that your hero and his allies cannot see.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D03_phrasesA_2_textMale.txt
file.text: To lift the shadow from the shaded parts of the map, you may move closer to them.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D03_phrasesB_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Catastrophe!! Someone has snuck up to the base's gate!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D03_phrasesB_1_textMale.txt
file.text: Shaded areas of the map indicate areas that your hero and his allies cannot see.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D03_phrasesB_2_textMale.txt
file.text: To lift the shadow from the shaded parts of the map, you may move closer to them.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D04_2_LMC_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Click on an enemy with the LEFT mouse button to attack. Your hero will automatically continue attacking the target, in the absence of other orders.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D04_2_RMC_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Click on an enemy with the RIGHT mouse button to attack. Your hero will automatically continue attacking the target, in the absence of other orders.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D04_3_phrasesA_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: Oh, what a dangerous beauty you are!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D04_3_phrasesB_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Put a spark in their eye!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D04_phrasesA_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: I knew that we'd run into the Adornians sooner or later! Spying on us, boys?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D04_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Something smells of paint... Should have known—a band of Adornians!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D04_phrasesB_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: Hey! Look there—Dokhts! Time to begin the dance, ladies and gentlemen!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D04_phrasesB_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Dokhts!? Why am I not surprised?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D05_1_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Upon destroying enemies, you receive Prime. The amount of Prime you have available is displayed by your PRIME RESERVOIR.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D05_2_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Prime is used to activate talents. To activate a talent, click the QUICK ACTIVATION icon.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D06_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Notice that the activated talent has appeared in your ACTION PANEL.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D07_phrasesA_1_textFemale.txt
file.text: What a spectacular steed you have there! Now tell me, who are you?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D07_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: What manner of Touched are you? And where is Moguta?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D07_phrasesA_2_textFemale.txt
file.text: I'm Ramon, the new hero. Moguta has gone off exploring and told me to greet any visitors while he's away.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D07_phrasesA_2_textMale.txt
file.text: I'm Ramon, the new hero around here. Moguta has gone off exploring, and left me to guard the base.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D07_phrasesA_3_textFemale.txt
file.text: I see... Say, do you hear that?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D07_phrasesA_6_textFemale.txt
file.text: I'll go light Moguta's path to victory.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D07_phrasesA_6_textMale.txt
file.text: Looks like the old fellow has found a bit of adventure close to home!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D07_phrasesB_1_textFemale.txt
file.text: If the frogs around here are that big, I wonder what the mosquitoes are like?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D07_phrasesB_1_textMale.txt
file.text: Well, well. What an... unusual... cavalryman.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D07_phrasesB_2_textFemale.txt
file.text: I'm a hero too, by the way—Frogmouth is the name! I'm quite flattered that Takeshi asked me to greet such a beautiful…

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D07_phrasesB_2_textMale.txt
file.text: I'm a hero too, by the way—Frogmouth is the name! Takeshi has left me in charge while he's off exploring...

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D07_phrasesB_3_textFemale.txt
file.text: Shhh! Quiet! Did you hear that?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D07_phrasesB_3_textMale.txt
file.text: Shhh! Quiet! Did you hear that?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D07_phrasesB_6_textFemale.txt
file.text: Takeshi's off having fun, and he didn't even invite me?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D07_phrasesB_6_textMale.txt
file.text: Ha! Takeshi's having a bit of fun!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D08_1_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: To use a talent, click it with the LEFT mouse button, or use the HOT KEY by pressing "1" on the keyboard.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D08_3_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Talents are much more powerful than a hero's usual attacks.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesA_1_textFemale.txt
file.text: When a beautiful woman arrives late, the clever man apologizes for being early.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: Perhaps your skills are growing still? What news have you, Moguta?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesA_2_textFemale.txt
file.text: Sorry, Ash, but I'm not one for your courtly politeness. The blasted Adornians are on the opposite side, constructing their base!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesA_2_textMale.txt
file.text: Bad news, I'm afraid. The Adornians are on the opposite side, building their base!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesA_3_textFemale.txt
file.text: We must destroy the heart of the enemy base: their Art Temple!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesA_3_textMale.txt
file.text: We must destroy the heart of the enemy base: their Art Temple!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesA_4_textFemale.txt
file.text: But first, we have to take out their Armory.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesA_4_textMale.txt
file.text: But first, we have to take out their Armory.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesA_5_textFemale.txt
file.text: But first things first. We'll have to destroy the towers along the security perimeter.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesA_5_textMale.txt
file.text: But first things first. We'll have to destroy the towers along the security perimeter.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesA_6_textFemale.txt
file.text: I cannot permit such a fragile beauty to enter the enemy's lair! Onwards!!!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesA_6_textMale.txt
file.text: Time for action! Where's the tower around here? It's time we take it out! Hurrah!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesA_7_textFemale.txt
file.text: What a fool. Haven't I taught him never to approach a tower alone!?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesA_7_textMale.txt
file.text: Well, he certainly hopped himself into quite a mess. Haven't I taught him never to approach a tower alone!?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesA_8_textFemale.txt
file.text: I'd best return to base and sort him out. Here, have a Healing Potion—it should come in handy.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesA_8_textMale.txt
file.text: I'd best return to base and sort him out. Here, have a Healing Potion—it should come in handy.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesB_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: Well, look who's honoring us with her presence!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesB_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Where on earth have you been, Gale?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesB_1_textFemale.txt
file.text: Hello, Takeshi. I hope you appreciate I was here to assist you in your hour of need...

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesB_1_textMale.txt
file.text: I can always recognize old Takeshi by the absence of the words "please" and "thank you" from his vocabulary.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesB_2_textFemale.txt
file.text: Oh, aye—a good deal! But our problem remains: the Dokhts are building an outpost on the opposite bank!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesB_2_textMale.txt
file.text: There's no time for courtly formalities now, my friend. The Dokhts are building an outpost on the opposite bank!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesB_3_textFemale.txt
file.text: We must destroy the heart of the enemy base: their Science Lodge!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesB_3_textMale.txt
file.text: We must destroy the heart of the enemy base: their Science Lodge!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesB_4_textFemale.txt
file.text: But first, we'll have to take out their Armory.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesB_4_textMale.txt
file.text: But first, we'll have to take out their Armory.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesB_5_textFemale.txt
file.text: But first things first: we need to destroy the towers along their perimeter.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesB_5_textMale.txt
file.text: But first things first: we need to destroy the towers along their perimeter.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesB_6_textFemale.txt
file.text: I'll prove it! She'll see what a good Destroyer old Frogmouth can be! Ribbit!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesB_6_textMale.txt
file.text: The Dokhts will build ten more towers while you stand around chatting! And only I can stop them! RIBBIT!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesB_7_textFemale.txt
file.text: I've warned him never to approach a tower alone!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesB_7_textMale.txt
file.text: What a fool! Oh, I've warned him! Never approach a tower alone!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesB_8_textFemale.txt
file.text: Ok, I'm returning to base. Here, some Healing Potions for your journey -- they'll come in handy.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D09_phrasesB_8_textMale.txt
file.text: Well, I'll return to base. Here, have some Healing Potions. They'll come in handy.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D10_2_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: The potions you received are also displayed on the Action Panel, alongside your current talents. To use one, LEFT-click the potion of your choice, or press its corresponding hotkey.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D11_phrasesA_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: The strength of my fire is nearly equal to my dazzling beauty.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D11_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: The stones were strong, but the mortar was weak.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D11_phrasesB_0_textMale.txt
file.text: There's a bit of divine judgment in my lightning.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D12_10_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: The Talent window can now be closed.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D12_1_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: You have enough Prime to activate another talent. Click its Quick Activation icon.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D12_2_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Very well. Heroes can use a variety of different talents. To see all of your hero's talents, click on the Prime Reservoir.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D12_3_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Excellent! You have enough Prime to activate one of two available talents. Activate one of the available talents now.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D12_4_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Activating a talent increases the hero's LEVEL and makes him or her more powerful

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D12_5_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Every FOUR levels, a new STAGE of talents is unlocked for the hero. The higher the stage, the more powerful the talents it contains.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D12_6_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: There are two types of talents. ACTIVE talents let you use heroic abilities. Their icons are surrounded by a box.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D12_7_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: PASSIVE talents, on the other hand, give the hero persistent bonus effects.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D12_8_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Select any available talent. You now have enough Prime for any of them.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D12_9_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Press the Prime Reservoir button to open the talent window.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D13_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: To close the talent window, click the Prime Indicator again.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D14_phrasesA_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: Wonder what the most flammable object is around here… Maybe there's something explosive!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D14_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Freedom is the ability to choose.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D14_phrasesB_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: Wonder how many fireballs I can juggle at once…

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D15_2_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Enemy heroes are dangerous opponents who can also use talents.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D15_phrasesA_1_textFemale.txt
file.text: Well! A girl who plays with fire!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D15_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: What the? A little flying man!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D15_phrasesA_2_textFemale.txt
file.text: Hey there, Rumbler! Don't you think that you're getting just a little chubby from all that Prime?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D15_phrasesA_2_textMale.txt
file.text: Ah, hello Rumbler. How are your heroic talents holding up under all that extra weight?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D15_phrasesB_2_textFemale.txt
file.text: All men think the same thing, and what's worse, they all think it with the same words.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D15_phrasesB_2_textMale.txt
file.text: That's the gleam of my glory, big guy.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D16_phrasesA_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: Ach! One wrong decision—and you're dead.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D16_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: Need to get a good night's sleep!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D16_phrasesA_2_textMale.txt
file.text: Defeating an enemy hero earns your hero a large amount of Prime.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D16_phrasesB_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Damn. My helmet slipped over my eyes for a second!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D16_phrasesB_1_textFemale.txt
file.text: ...turn over after five minutes and fry until crispy...

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D16_phrasesB_2_textMale.txt
file.text: Defeating an enemy hero earns your hero a large amount of Prime.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D17_1_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Be cautious! Your health is low! Use a Healing Potion by clicking on it with the left mouse button, or selecting it with the corresponding hotkey.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D17_2_phrasesA_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: Those bastards messed up my hair! Thanks, Moguta. Healing potions can be very useful!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D17_2_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Damn. Tough one. Good thinking, Moguta! I'd be in bad shape without your potions!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D17_2_phrasesB_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: The most important thing is to take the Healing Potion in time. A couple of sips and my flame will burn as brightly as ever!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D17_2_phrasesB_0_textMale.txt
file.text: What could be better than a well-aged potion after a fierce fight? And it's good for you, too!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D18_phrasesA_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: Something about this building isn't quite right... Ah, that's it! It needs a good fire!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D18_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: The Armory here was spoiling the scenery.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D18_phrasesB_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: What an awful building. It's just begging for some cleansing fire!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D18_phrasesB_0_textMale.txt
file.text: All of this Dokht metal is ideal for conducting my lightning.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D19_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: After the destruction of the enemy Armory, the guard will come to the hero's aid.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D19_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: Forward, men! Chop them to bits!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D19_phrasesA_2_textMale.txt
file.text: I'm alive! I'm alive! RIBBIT! I mean... Hurray!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D19_phrasesA_3_textMale.txt
file.text: Oh I'll make you wish you were still dead! Two extra work details, as punishment for getting yourself killed without even gaining a tactical advantage.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D19_phrasesA_4_textFemale.txt
file.text: This pretty little house can pack quite a punch.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D19_phrasesA_4_textMale.txt
file.text: Hold there! That Adornian monstrosity can pack quite a punch!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D19_phrasesB_0_textMale.txt
file.text: After the destruction of the enemy Armory, the guard will come to the hero's aid.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D19_phrasesB_1_textMale.txt
file.text: Any Adornian with a sword is just like an Adornian without one... just with a sword, that's all!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D19_phrasesB_2_textMale.txt
file.text: Ready for adventure and unfading glory!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D19_phrasesB_3_textMale.txt
file.text: Adventure can wait. First, write the hieroglyphic character for "subordination" 999 times. As punishment for getting yourself killed without even gaining a tactical advantage!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D19_phrasesB_4_textFemale.txt
file.text: Attack the Lodge! Just wait until it...

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D19_phrasesB_4_textMale.txt
file.text: I couldn't care less, of course, but if you rush to it altogether…

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D19_phrasesB_5_textFemale.txt
file.text: Well, that was a bit reckless…

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D20_phrasesA_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: Now it's time! Let's knock them out before their Temple gathers enough Prime for another blow. Let's have some fun!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D20_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Now, let's hit it with all we've got! Now, before the Temple gathers enough Prime for another blow!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D20_phrasesB_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: Now, boys, now!—Before the Lodge stores up enough Prime for another blow!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D20_phrasesB_0_textMale.txt
file.text: And now—forward! Before the Lodge gathers enough Prime for another blow. Smash it to pieces, men!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D21_phrasesA_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: Ash, my spark, hold on! I'll take care of them! Oops. What? Is it all over already?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D21_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: Forward! For the Imperium! Hold the line! Your hero has arrived! Oops... I'm too late.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D21_phrasesA_1_textFemale.txt
file.text: Oh, we're just getting started. Congratulations on your first victory!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D21_phrasesA_1_textMale.txt
file.text: No problem. There will be plenty of time for more fighting. We've won this battle, but the war still rages on.

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D21_phrasesB_0_textFemale.txt
file.text: I'm a hero, not a calligrapher! I'll show her... She'll see... Oh. You handled it all by yourself?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D21_phrasesB_0_textMale.txt
file.text: I wrote it all down! Now can we finally get to the fight?! Let's do this! What do you mean, it's all over?

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D21_phrasesB_1_textFemale.txt
file.text: I was inspired by your heroic death. I so yearned to avenge you!

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D21_phrasesB_1_textMale.txt
file.text: Well, you've really croaked it up this time, my friend...

file.name: Dialog\SessionTutorial\Mission1\TM1_D23_phrasesA_0_textMale.txt
file.text: To receive Prime, you need only be nearby enemies when they are defeated. However, you will receive substantially more Prime if you are the one who finishes them off.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\ts1\ts11_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
Your first battle with the enemy is approaching. It's time to show that your lessons in the Academy of Lords have paid off. March into hell with your faithful hero by your side and defeat the enemy.

Win tutorial mode in the Borderlands. Quests and tips will help you learn the basics of the game quickly.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\ts1\ts11_qA_objectives_0_Text.txt
file.text: Win your first battle — First Strike.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\t1\t11_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
There are many ways of getting the information you need, and an experienced lord will never scoff at even the most dubious ones. The merest rumor can sometimes be a source of important news, or even prevent a disaster.
Build a Tavern! Weary travelers, peasants, and even heroes will have a place to unwind, and the owner will tell you everything ale-loosened tongues have blurted out.

Select the Construction Panel and build a Tavern.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\t1\t12_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
The more comfortable and upscale our Tavern is, the richer our guests will be — which means they’ll have better rumors for us. If we can upgrade our Tavern, new quests will become available.
A new quest becomes available in the Tavern every day. One you complete it, you can send your heroes out on Patrol until the next daily quest becomes available.

Upgrade the Tavern to level 2 and complete one quest in it.
Warning: The Patrol quest doesn’t count.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\t1\t12_qA_objectives_1_Text.txt
file.text: Complete one quest in the Tavern other than Patrol

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\s5\s53_qA_04454acbb8d04c60837d535d17da7c7d_message.txt
file.text: My Lady, you haven't participated in any battles for X days. Would you like to decrease your heroes' rating by Y for a more comfortable game?

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\s5\s53_qA_1fedb032092e490faab63f2543798d3e_message.txt
file.text: My Lord, you haven't participated in any battles for X days. Would you like to decrease your heroes' rating by Y for a more comfortable game?

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\s5\s53_qA_40f6e230a1a14525a64bcfebdf032130_message.txt
file.text: My Lady, you haven't participated in any battles for X days. Would you like to decrease your heroes' rating by Y for a more comfortable game?

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\s5\s53_qA_46985b04b15246948d3ca2a03b12e7c3_message.txt
file.text: My Lord, you haven't participated in any battles for X days. Would you like to decrease your heroes' rating by Y for a more comfortable game?

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\s5\s53_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
While you were away, the enemy has captured an important source of Prime. Time to take it back!
Incidentally, you might want to review the rankings of your heroes — they have been sitting in their castle for too long.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\s5\s53_qA_objectives_1_Text.txt
file.text: Achieve three victories in the Borderlands

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\s1\s11_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
The heroes never take part in battles in vain. However, collected-in-battle prime can be easily lost when the fight is over. The hero's Mastery grows still, though.

Reach a Mastery level of 2 on any hero, enter the Hall of Heroes and upgrade one of the basic characteristics of a hero.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\s1\s11_qA_objectives_0_Text.txt
file.text: Upgrade one of the hero's characteristics

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\s1\s12_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
Our castle is strong enough to engage new heroes. It is always unsafe on the borders – even if an enemy is hiding, the Touched are on the watch, and new warriors always come in handy. This is absolutely our advantage - the more heroes are in the castle, the more battles their Lord can take. And a weary hero is ineffective in battles.

Choose Hero's Panel and hire a new hero.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\s1\s13_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
Our enemy is strong and devious, and new skirmishes are turning this into a long war. In order to react to such a strong opponent we must train hard, working to increase the skills of your heroes.

Send your heroes to battle, until one of them reaches a Mastery level of 3.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\s1\s13_qA_objectives_0_Text.txt
file.text: Reach a Mastery level of 3 on any hero

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\pve1\pve11_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
We sometimes find ancient artifacts of Prime Zone. Just like that, a researcher of the Prime Zone Willow has found an artifact, which, when charged, can destroy all the Touched nearby in a moment.
We must try out this spectacular ability and for this reason, we need to set out to Prime Zone and perform an experiment. Willow already awaits you at the castle gates.

Warning: "Challenges" is a mode for a group of 5 players.

Select "Challenges" and then click "To Battle!" to pick a hero and start fighting.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\pve1\pve11_qA_objectives_0_Text.txt
file.text: Win in "Challenges" on any difficulty mode.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\o1\o11_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
Greetings from the Capital! I am the Herald of the Winter Competition, and I have brought the Baton of Winter Flame relay race to your castle. I have passed many castles along the way, and now it is your turn to compete for the prize. While the flame is lit, fight three battles against worthy opponents on the battlegrounds. If you are victorious, you will be rewarded generously.
So, what are you waiting for? Go! I hereby declare the Winter Competition open!

Win once in Borderlands, Outpost and Switcheroo.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\ny2\ny21_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
One last step separates you and the holiday spirit. Send the Snow Maiden a silver coin to get her to let Santa Claus go and allow him to make all the wishes that were made during the ringing of the bells come true!

Happy New Year!

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\ny1\ny11_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
December is finally here. The ground is covered in snowflakes. Everything is as white as can be. Christmas Eve is coming. But what's Christmas without a tree and presents?! Grow a Christmas tree in your castle, and you'll get more presents than you can handle!

Select the Construction Panel and plant a Christmas Tree.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\ny1\ny12_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
The Christmas tree is ready. How else can you spread holiday cheer? Fill your pockets with sweets, hang the mistletoe, and bake lots of Christmas cookies! Keep it up, you're not done yet! The celebration is about to reach a whole new level! Write a holiday speech and practice it in front of the mirror. Don't be embarrassed, no one can hear you. This is going to be a Christmas to remember!

Go to theChristmas Tree and collect 50 Prime Crystals.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\ny1\ny12_qA_objectives_0_Text.txt
file.text: Collect 50 crystals from the Christmas Tree

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\n1\n11_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
We must prove to the crown that your appointment as Lord of this castle was no oversight. Only after achieving enough victories over other rulers starting their career can you participate in battles with any lords.

Achieve 5 victories over the enemy in any mode.
Attention: two victories in Outpost mode will be counted as one.
Victories in Practice and Challenges modes don't count.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\m4\m41_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
The secret of being a successful lord is correctly allocating resources. That’s why you should regularly put on fairs in your castle. Just look at how much stuff that you need can be found there! After all, fairs are attended by all kinds of merchants, craftsmen, and travelers. I recommend you regularly check the available wares.
To get started, get a spot ready for the construction of a store.

Select the Construction Panel and build a Fair.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\m4\m42_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
Merchants from every corner of Praya bring to the Fair all kinds of wonders and rare goods. Unusual vibrant crimson Prime Crystals are available at merchants' counters more and more often. Our blacksmiths have found a new reforging formula that lets them use these crystals to create new talents of unprecedented power, however our warehouses are empty.

Go to the Fair and buy8 legendary crystals. If no crystals are available, wait for the next daily shipment or pay to refresh the list of available goods.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\m4\m42_qA_objectives_0_Text.txt
file.text: Buy 8 legendary crystals at the Fair.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\m4\m43_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
The greatest task of a lord is to increase his heroes’ power to the maximum level. The tension of the situation along the borders of the empire has reached incredible levels, and our best heroes are expending all of their energy in battle. We must help them turn the tide of war. Our craftsmen are ready to forge their first legendary talent. To do this, places several exclusive talents and legendary crystals in the Forge.

Enter the Talent Forge and create a legendary talent.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\m4\m43_qA_objectives_0_Text.txt
file.text: Use 5 orange talents and 8 legendary Prime Crystals to produce 1 legendary talent in the Talent Forge.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\m3\m30_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
The latest technologies developed by our sages have made it possible to upgrade the talents heroes receive. To upgrade a talent, it is necessary to sacrifice several other talents, as well as a few Prime crystals. The higher the level of a talent, the greater the cost to upgrade it.
I have ordered five identical Dragon's Heart talents from the capital. You can use them for upgrades if you wish—after all, if you upgrade a talent with an identical talent, it will instantly reach the next level.

Upgrade any talent to level 5 and visit the paid services page of the Prime World site.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\m3\m30_qA_objectives_1_Text.txt
file.text: Learn about the most effective ways to spend gold on the Prime World web page.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\m3\m31_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
Only the mightiest of heroes can hope to stand among the Imperial Elites. The hero gains new Special, Rare, and Legendary talents along with new levels of mastery, increasing the hero's Power.

Increase any hero's Power to 1500.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\m3\m32_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
Prime crystals aren't only used for talent production—they have lots of other uses. They can be used to build and upgrade the Hero Stronghold.
A Stronghold is a special building where different heroes live and train. It is capable of boosting the heroes' stats in battle.

Build any Hero Stronghold and upgrade it to Level 2.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\m3\m32_qA_objectives_1_Text.txt
file.text: Upgrade any Hero Stronghold to level 2

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\m2\m21_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
In order to make a hero more powerful, you have to supply him with Special, Rare, and Legendary talents. You can get these in battle, but you can also create them in your castle by using Prime Crystals.
The most important mission for a Lord of the Dokht Imperium is to train powerful heroes. These are the heroes who will participate in the most important battles and receive the most coveted rewards.

Build the Talent Forge and produce 10 talents.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\m1\m11_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
The acquisition of Prime must be every lord's primary goal. After all, you can hardly hope to equip your heroes with large quantities of epic talents without the use of Prime Crystals.
Prime Crystal production, on the other hand, requires that you produce enormous quantities of ore.

Build a Mine and upgrade it to level 9.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\m1\m12_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
In order for a Prime Distiller to work more efficiently, it will have to be upgraded to at least level 2. Then it will produce more crystals!
And, if you upgrade it to level 12, you will be able to receive even more crystals, but that will come later.

Build a Prime Distiller and upgrade it to level 2, then gather at least one prime crystal.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\m1\m12_qA_objectives_1_Text.txt
file.text: Upgrade a Prime Distiller to level 2

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\m1\m12_qA_objectives_2_Text.txt
file.text: Gather at least one prime crystal

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\m1\m13_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
And so our castle is now ready for large-scale Prime Crystal production. Prime is more than just a resource—in the post-Cataclysm world, Prime Crystals are worth their weight in gold. This is why experienced engineers in the capital are always ready to speed up Prime Crystal production if a lord is willing to spend a little coin.
Enter the Prime Distillery and double the Prime Crystal production.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\hidden\hidden1_qA_Title.txt
file.text: Replace the map Tutor1 with Tutor2 in the Tutorial slot

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\h2\h21_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
Open wide the castle gates
Gather all your honest mates!
May the oaken tables wide
Laden be from side to side!
Pour the vintage sweet and old
Into chalices of gold!
May there lavish be libations
At our joyous celebration!

Store 5,000 food and give it to Lord Pumpkin.
By the way: you will receive a epic talent once you complete this set of tasks.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\h2\h22_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
No more victuals to be had?
Fellow, do not look so sad!
I shall entertain our guests,
You take care of all the rest!

Store 7,500 food and give it to Lord Pumpkin.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\h2\h23_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
We have had a glorious feast
And that is to say the least
But all good things, they must pass
Shall we drink the parting glass?

Store 10,000 food and give it to Lord Pumpkin.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\h1\h11_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
I once was the lord of this beautiful land
I ruled with a fair, just and merciful hand
But great was my pride and my troubles so few...
The Cataclysm's taught me a lesson or two
Now I'm enslaved by Prime, and for but a week
May I leave the Prime Zone, justice to seek

Your castles were built on lands that were mine
You must pay my price, you must pay my fine
But there's a condition to this noble task:
No blood on those coins! That is all that I ask!

Receive 666 silver from the Residential Buildings, the Manufacture or the Pet's House.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\h1\h11_qA_Title.txt
file.text: The Lord of the Old Empire

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\h1\h12_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
Let us celebrate my freedom
Call the guests and let us greet 'em
Hurry up to do my bidding
My tired soul from sadness ridding!
Decorate your home with flourish
For my mortal sight to nourish
If I smile a mirthful smile,
I shall make it worth your while!

Buy and place 10 decorations in the castle.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\h1\h13_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
Away with the dirt! Away with the grime!
Today is the day, and now is the time!
Let there be soap! Let there be lather!
Not one speck of dirt, our hero to bother!

Build an Inn and bathe any hero there.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\h1\h14_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
Now we're ready for our feast
I'm overjoyed to say the least
Now the only thing we need
Is a bunch of guests to feed!

And to pump them full of cheer
We must have a lot of beer!
Call for ceasefire, call for peace
Put Adornians at ease!
And if they decline your offer,
Bring them sealed up in a coffer!

Defeat your foes once in any mode.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\h1\h14_qA_objectives_0_Text.txt
file.text: Defeat the enemy in any PvP - mode

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\darken\d11_qA_Title.txt
file.text: Insert a talent in an empty slot

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\c4\c41_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
While taking part in dangerous campaigns, heroes receive multiple talents and it can be a hard decision which are useless and which should be saved for future heroes. The place where you can store all those talents is limited.
A Library can help with this problem as it allows you to expand the limit of stored talents for heroes.

Choose Construction panel and build a Library.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\c4\c42_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
Even a new Library eventually will be full of unused talents. But wait, don't hurry to build another one, as space for buildings is limited in your castle. It is better to build a second floor for the one you already have!

Upgrade a Library to level 2. Click on the building and press "Upgrade" on the building's icon.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\c3\c31_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
Talents for heroes can not only be earned on the battlefield but also grown from Prime Crystals, right in the castle. Crystallizing Prime is not an easy task, and only a few workmen are able to master it, but your castle has already begun to attract them.
Build a Prime Distiller and wait for the masters to bind the liquid Prime into a solid crystal.

Select the Construction Panel and build a Prime Distiller.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\c3\c32_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
Creating talents for your heroes from the manufactured Prime Crystals is an even finer science than growing the crystals themselves. Build a Talent Forge, put a Prime Crystal inside and hope for the best! Even the masters themselves cannot predict what sort of talent will be born from the Prime.

Select the Construction Panel and build a Talent Forge.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\c2\c21_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
It’s time to take care of our castle's economy! After all, a castle is a lot more than just thick walls and faithful guardsmen. It’s also a town where artisans and merchants can make major contributions to their lord's treasury!
But one thing at a time. First you need to make sure your subjects have enough supplies.

Select the Construction Panel and build a Farm.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\c2\c22_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
Border castles have always attracted the most courageous. As a lord, a soldier, or an artisan, you can always find a decent job here.
You've stockpiled a good supply of food, and already your castle's population is growing. Now, you need to build some residences. The more people live in your castle, the stronger your workforce is!

Select the Construction Panel and build one of the Residences.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\c2\c23_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
Every lord has to take care of the needs of his own castle. And this requires resources; you can't always count on the government's generosity! Better to improve production here, on site.

Select the Construction Panel and build a Lumber Mill and a Mine.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\c2\c24_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
The cellars of the castle are full of resources, and the buildings are all still working. Of course, you can stop them, but that wouldn't be very beneficial. I have a better idea: we need a special warehouse for our resources.

Select the Construction Panel and build a Warehouse.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\c1\c11_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
A mighty castle is a solid foundation for organizing military campaigns as well as a resting place for your brave heroes. Sadly, this little swath of land can hardly be considered a proper castle. Before proper construction can begin, you will have to expand your territory.

Open the Construction Panel and select Territory Expansion. Your Inn is at last ready to serve your heroes! Now all that's left is to move your tired heroes there, speeding up their recovery! The Inn has several modes of operation, allowing the hero to recover different amounts of Vigor.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\c1\c12_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
After returning from a long journey, weary heroes love to relax and restore their Vigor at the Inn. Rested characters receive more experience in battle and win more talents.

Select the Construction Panel and build an Inn.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\c1\c13_qA_Description.txt
file.text:
Your Inn is at last ready to serve your heroes! Now all that's left is to move your tired heroes there, speeding up their recovery! The Inn has several modes of operation, allowing the hero to recover different amounts of Vigor.

Enter the Inn, drag a weary hero from the lower panel into one of the slots in the building, and click the Start button for one of the Inn's modes.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Dokt\c1\c13_qA_objectives_0_Text.txt
file.text: Restore hero's Vigor at the Inn.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Darken\open_12_advices_0.txt
file.text: You have received a new talent! Drag the talent out of the Library into the hero's talent set.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Darken\open_s23_1_advices_0.txt
file.text: You have received a new talent! Drag a talent from the Library to your hero’s talent set and replace a weaker talent with it.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Darken\open_s23_2_advices_0.txt
file.text: Click on the “Sell talent” button, then select the talent you want to sell.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Darken\open_s24_advices_0.txt
file.text: You have to unassign a talent, in order to use it with other heroes. Click on the “Unassign Talent” button, then select the talent you want to unassign.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\ts1\ts11_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
Your first battle with the enemy is approaching. It's time to show that your lessons in the Academy of Lords have paid off. March into hell with your faithful hero by your side and defeat the enemy.

Win tutorial mode in the Borderlands. Quests and tips will help you learn the basics of the game quickly.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\ts1\ts11_qB_objectives_0_Text.txt
file.text: Win your first battle — First Strike.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\t1\t11_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
There are many ways of getting the information you need, and an experienced lord will never scoff at even the most dubious ones. The merest rumor can sometimes be a source of important news, or even prevent a disaster.
Build a Teahouse! Weary travelers, peasants, and even heroes will have a place to unwind, and the owner will tell you everything hookah-loosened tongues have blurted out.

Select the Construction Panel and build a Teahouse.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\t1\t12_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
The more comfortable and upscale our Teahouse is, the richer our guests will be — which means they’ll have better rumors for us. If we can upgrade our Teahouse, new quests will become available.
A new quest becomes available in the Teahouse every day. One you complete it, you can send your heroes out on Patrol until the next daily quest becomes available.

Upgrade the Teahouse to level 2 and complete one quest in it.
Warning: The Patrol quest doesn’t count.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\t1\t12_qB_objectives_1_Text.txt
file.text: Complete three Teahouse quests other than Patrol

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\s5\s53_qB_09a805f2f45147cf84cab5f0e265ca09_message.txt
file.text: My Lady, you haven't participated in any battles for X days. Would you like to decrease your heroes' rating by Y for a more comfortable game?

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\s5\s53_qB_2b1818626c4c43d6a503e6b12cd9f768_message.txt
file.text: My Lord, you haven't participated in any battles for X days. Would you like to decrease your heroes' rating by Y for a more comfortable game?

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\s5\s53_qB_48c2ebbdc1294314b1580c587fd61a3b_message.txt
file.text: My Lady, you haven't participated in any battles for X days. Would you like to decrease your heroes' rating by Y for a more comfortable game?

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\s5\s53_qB_4cbac48740d143c8b881fd8c7ed5b1c5_message.txt
file.text: My Lord, you haven't participated in any battles for X days. Would you like to decrease your heroes' rating by Y for a more comfortable game?

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\s5\s53_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
While you were away, the enemy has captured an important source of Prime. Time to take it back!
Incidentally, you might want to review the rankings of your heroes — they have been sitting in their castle for too long.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\s5\s53_qB_objectives_1_Text.txt
file.text: Achieve three victories in the Borderlands

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\s1\s11_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
The heroes never take part in battles in vain. However, collected-in-battle prime can be easily lost when the fight is over. The hero's Mastery grows still, though.

Reach a Mastery level of 2 on any hero, enter the Hall of Heroes and upgrade one of the basic characteristics of a hero.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\s1\s11_qB_objectives_0_Text.txt
file.text: Upgrade one of the hero's characteristics

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\s1\s12_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
Our castle is strong enough to engage new heroes. It is always unsafe on the borders – even if an enemy is hiding, the Touched are on the watch, and new warriors always come in handy. This is absolutely our advantage - the more heroes are in the castle, the more battles their Lord can take. And a weary hero is ineffective in battles.

Choose Hero's Panel and hire a new hero.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\s1\s13_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
Our enemy is strong and devious, and new skirmishes are turning this into a long war. In order to react to such a strong opponent we must train hard, working to increase the skills of your heroes.

Send your heroes to battle, until one of them reaches a Mastery level of 3.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\s1\s13_qB_objectives_0_Text.txt
file.text: Reach a Mastery level of 3 on any hero

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\pve1\pve11_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
We sometimes find ancient artifacts of Prime Zone. Just like that, a researcher of the Prime Zone Willow has found an artifact, which, when charged, can destroy all the Touched nearby in a moment.
We must try out this spectacular ability and for this reason, we need to set out to Prime Zone and perform an experiment. Willow already awaits you at the castle gates.

Warning: "Challenges" is a mode for a group of 5 players.

Select "Challenges" and then click "To Battle!" to pick a hero and start fighting.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\pve1\pve11_qB_objectives_0_Text.txt
file.text: Win in "Challenges" on any difficulty mode.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\o1\o11_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
Greetings from the Capital! I am the Herald of the Winter Competition, and I have brought the Baton of Winter Flame relay race to your castle. I have passed many castles along the way, and now it is your turn to compete for the prize. While the flame is lit, fight three battles against worthy opponents on the battlegrounds. If you are victorious, you will be rewarded generously.
So, what are you waiting for? Go! I hereby declare the Winter Competition open!

Win once in Borderlands, Outpost and Switcheroo.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\ny2\ny21_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
One last step separates you and the holiday spirit. Send the Snow Maiden a silver coin to get her to let Santa Claus go and allow him to make all the wishes that were made during the ringing of the bells come true!

Happy New Year!

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\ny1\ny11_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
December is finally here. The ground is covered in snowflakes. Everything is as white as can be. Christmas Eve is coming. But what's Christmas without a tree and presents?! Grow a Christmas tree in your castle, and you'll get more presents than you can handle!

Select the Construction Panel and plant a Christmas Tree.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\ny1\ny12_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
The Christmas tree is ready. How else can you spread holiday cheer? Fill your pockets with sweets, hang the mistletoe, and bake lots of Christmas cookies! Keep it up, you're not done yet! The celebration is about to reach a whole new level! Write a holiday speech and practice it in front of the mirror. Don't be embarrassed, no one can hear you. This is going to be a Christmas to remember!

Go to the Christmas Tree and collect 50 Prime Crystals.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\ny1\ny12_qB_objectives_0_Text.txt
file.text: Collect 50 crystals from the Christmas Tree

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\n1\n11_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
We must prove to the crown that your appointment as Lord of this castle was no oversight. Only after achieving enough victories over other rulers starting their career can you participate in battles with any lords.

Achieve 5 victories over the enemy in any mode.
Attention: two victories in Outpost mode will be counted as one.
Victories in Practice and Challenges modes don't count.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\m4\m41_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
The secret of being a successful lord is correctly allocating resources. That’s why you should regularly put on fairs in your castle. You’ll see how much stuff that you need can be found there! After all, fairs are attended by all kinds of merchants, craftsmen, and travelers. I recommend you regularly check the available wares.
To get started, get a spot ready for the construction of a store.

Select the Construction Panel and build a Fair.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\m4\m42_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
Merchants from every corner of Praya bring to the Fair all kinds of wonders and rare goods. Unusual vibrant crimson Prime Crystals are available at merchants' counters more and more often. Our blacksmiths have found a new reforging formula that lets them use these crystals to create new talents of unprecedented power, however our warehouses are empty.

Go to the Fair and buy8 legendary crystals. If no crystals are available, wait for the next daily shipment or pay to refresh the list of available goods.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\m4\m42_qB_objectives_0_Text.txt
file.text: Buy 8 legendary crystals at the Fair.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\m4\m43_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
The greatest task of a lord is to increase his heroes’ power to the maximum level. The tension of the situation along the borders of the empire has reached incredible levels, and our best heroes are expending all of their energy in battle. We must help them turn the tide of war. Our craftsmen are ready to forge their first legendary talent. To do this, places several exclusive talents and legendary crystals in the Talent Garden.

Enter the Talent Garden and create a legendary talent.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\m4\m43_qB_objectives_0_Text.txt
file.text: Use 5 orange talents and 8 legendary Prime Crystals to produce 1 legendary talent in the Talent Forge.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\m3\m30_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
The latest research conducted by our sorcerors has made it possible to upgrade the talents heroes receive. To upgrade a talent, it is necessary to sacrifice several other talents, as well as a few Prime crystals. The higher the level of a talent, the greater the cost to upgrade it.
I have ordered five identical Dragon's Heart talents from the capital. You can use them for upgrades if you wish—after all, if you upgrade a talent with an identical talent, it will instantly reach the next level.

Upgrade any talent to level 5 and visit the paid services page of the Prime World site.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\m3\m30_qB_objectives_1_Text.txt
file.text: Learn about the most effective ways to spend gold on the Prime World web page.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\m3\m31_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
Only the mightiest of heroes can hope to stand among the Kingdom Elites. The hero gains new Special, Rare, and Legendary talents along with new levels of mastery, increasing the hero's Power.

Increase any hero's Power to 1500.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\m3\m32_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
Prime crystals aren't only used for talent production—they have lots of other uses. They can be used to build and upgrade the Hero Stronghold.
A Stronghold is a special building where different heroes live and train. It is capable of boosting the heroes' stats in battle.

Build any Hero Stronghold and upgrade it to Level 2.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\m3\m32_qB_objectives_1_Text.txt
file.text: Upgrade any Hero Stronghold to level 2

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\m2\m21_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
In order to make a hero more powerful, you have to supply him with Special, Rare, and Legendary talents. You can get these in battle, but you can also create them in your castle by using Prime Crystals.
The most important mission for a Lord of the Dokht Imperium is to train powerful heroes. These are the heroes who will participate in the most important battles and receive the most coveted rewards.

Build the Talent Garden and produce 10 talents.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\m1\m11_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
The acquisition of Prime must be every lord's primary goal. After all, you can hardly hope to equip your heroes with large quantities of epic talents without the use of Prime Crystals.
Prime Crystal production, on the other hand, requires that you produce enormous quantities of rubber.

Build a Rubber-tree and upgrade it to level 9.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\m1\m12_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
In order for a Pearl Farm to work more efficiently, it will have to be upgraded to at least level 2. Then the farm will produce more crystals.
And, if you upgrade it to level 12, you will be able to receiveeven more crystals, but that will come later.

Build a Pearl Farm and upgrade it to level 2, then gather at least one Prime Crystal.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\m1\m12_qB_objectives_1_Text.txt
file.text: Upgrade a Pearl Farm to level 2

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\m1\m12_qB_objectives_2_Text.txt
file.text: Gather at least one prime crystal

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\m1\m13_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
And so our castle is now ready for large-scale Prime Crystal production. Prime is more than just a resource—in the post-Cataclysm world, Prime Crystals are worth their weight in gold. This is why experienced mages from the capital are always ready to speed up Prime Crystal production if a lord is willing to spend a little coin.

Enter the Pearl Farm and double the Prime Crystal production.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\h2\h21_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
Open wide the castle gates
Gather all your honest mates!
May the oaken tables wide
Laden be from side to side!
Pour the vintage sweet and old
Into chalices of gold!
May there lavish be libations
At our joyous celebration!

Store 5,000 food and give it to Lord Pumpkin.
By the way: you will receive a epic talent once you complete this set of tasks.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\h2\h22_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
No more victuals to be had?
Fellow, do not look so sad!
I shall entertain our guests,
You take care of all the rest!

Store 7,500 food and give it to Lord Pumpkin.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\h2\h23_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
We have had a glorious feast
And that is to say the least
But all good things, they must pass
Shall we drink the parting glass?

Store 10,000 food and give it to Lord Pumpkin.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\h1\h11_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
I once was the lord of this beautiful land
I ruled with a fair, just and merciful hand
But great was my pride and my troubles so few...
The Cataclysm's taught me a lesson or two
Now I'm enslaved by Prime, and for but a week
May I leave the Prime Zone, justice to seek

Your castles were built on lands that were mine
You must pay my price, you must pay my fine
But there's a condition to this noble task:
No blood on those coins! That is all that I ask!

Receive 666 silver from the Residential Buildings, the Weavers' Shop or the Pet's House.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\h1\h11_qB_Title.txt
file.text: The Lord of the Old Empire

file.text:
Let us celebrate my freedom
Call the guests and let us greet 'em
Hurry up to do my bidding
My tired soul from sadness ridding!
Decorate your home with flourish
For my mortal sight to nourish
If I smile a mirthful smile,
I shall make it worth your while!

Buy and place 10 decorations in the castle.

file.text:
Away with the dirt! Away with the grime!
Today is the day, and now is the time!
Let there be soap! Let there be lather!
Not one speck of dirt, our hero to bother!

Build a Spa and bathe any hero there.

file.text:
Now we're ready for our feast
I'm overjoyed to say the least
Now the only thing we need
Is a bunch of guests to feed!

And to pump them full of cheer
We must have a lot of beer!
Call for ceasefire, call for peace
Put those haughty Dokhts at ease!
And if they decline your offer,
Bring them sealed up in a coffer!

Defeat your foes once in any PvP - mode.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\h1\h14_qB_objectives_0_Text.txt
file.text: Defeat the enemy in any PvP - mode

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\darken\d11_qB_Title.txt
file.text: Insert a talent in an empty slot

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\c4\c41_qB_Description.txt
file.text:

A Library can help with this problem as it allows you to expand the limit of stored talents for heroes.

Choose Construction panel and build a Library.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\c4\c42_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
Even a new Library eventually will be full of unused talents. But wait, don't hurry to build another one, as space for buildings is limited in your castle. It is better to build a second floor for the one you already have!

Upgrade a Library to level 2. Click on the building and press "Upgrade" on the building's icon.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\c3\c31_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
Talents for heroes can not only be earned on the battlefield but also grown from Prime Crystals, right in the castle. Crystallizing Prime is not an easy task, and only a few workmen are able to master it, but your castle has already begun to attract them.
Build a Pearl Farm and wait for the masters to bind the liquid Prime into a solid crystal.

Select the Construction Panel and build a Pearl Farm.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\c3\c32_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
Creating talents from Prime Crystals is a delicate art which is still not well-known in the Kingdom. But I will teach you what you need to do. Build a Talent Garden, put a Prime Crystal inside, call your singers and musicians, and hope for the best! Nobody knows what talent will be produced.

Select the Construction Panel and build a Talent Garden.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\c2\c21_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
It’s time to take care of our castle's economy! After all, a castle is a lot more than just thick walls and faithful guardsmen. It’s also a town where artisans and merchants can make major contributions to their lord's treasury!
But one thing at a time. First you need to make sure your subjects have enough supplies.

Select the Construction Panel and build a Mushroom Farm.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\c2\c22_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
Border castles have always attracted the most courageous. As a lord, a soldier, or an artisan, you can always find a decent job here.
You've stockpiled a good supply of food, and already your castle's population is growing. Now, you need to build some residences. The more people live in your castle, the stronger your workforce is!

Select the Construction Panel and build a Mansion.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\c2\c23_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
Every lord has to take care of the needs of his own castle. And this requires resources; you can't always count on the government's generosity! Better to improve production here, on site.

Select the Construction Panel and build a Spinnery and a Rubber-tree.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\c2\c24_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
The cellars of the castle are full of resources, and the buildings are all still working. Of course, you can stop them, but that wouldn't be very beneficial. I have a better idea: we need a special warehouse for our resources.

Select the Construction Panel and build a Warehouse.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\c1\c11_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
A mighty castle is a solid foundation for organizing military campaigns as well as a resting place for your brave heroes. Sadly, this little swath of land can hardly be considered a proper castle. Before proper construction can begin, you will have to expand your territory.

Open the Construction Panel and select Territory Expansion.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\c1\c12_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
After returning from a long journey, weary heroes love to relax and restore their Vigor at the Spa. Rested characters receive more experience in battle and win more talents.

Select the Construction Panel and build a Spa.

file.name: Dialog\CastleTutorial\Ador\c1\c13_qB_Description.txt
file.text:
Your Spa is at last ready to serve your heroes! Now all that's left is to move your tired heroes there, speeding up their recovery! The Spa has several modes of operation, allowing the hero to recover different amounts of Vigor.

Enter the Spa, drag a weary hero from the lower panel into one of the slots in the building, and click the Start button for one of the Spa's modes.

file.name: Heroes\Bomber\_.HROB_lobbyData_heroDescriptionA.txt
file.text: \tOne can watch the work of an expert bomber for eternity. Plunging bombs, firecrackers, and even a special tracking missile — there is little that cannot be found in the Bomber's ammunition belt! Tirelessly, she fills the cans with inflammable napalm preparing the stage for the firework of cargo mortar bombs.\r\n\tAnd the more enemies are round the more unforgettable sight it will be!
